new_roles.description:
**Become a part of our caring community**
=========================================

Humana is committed to helping people achieve their best health by delivering innovative technology solutions that enable exceptional member and provider experiences. 
The Director, Quality Engineering – Test Data Management (EQE) is a senior technology leader responsible for defining, advancing, and operating Humana's enterprise Test Data Management (TDM) function within Enterprise Quality Engineering. Reporting to the VP, Quality Engineering, this role leads the strategy, operating model, and execution of secure, scalable, compliant, and automation-enabled test data capabilities that support software delivery across Humana's business and technology organizations. 
This leader is accountable for building and leading a high-performing organization responsible for core TDM services, including test data provisioning, synthetic data generation, masking, de-identification, data lifecycle management, and environment data coordination. The Director will partner closely with Quality Engineering, Engineering, Product, Architecture, DevOps, Infrastructure, Security, Privacy, Risk, and Data teams to ensure test data is available, fit for purpose, and aligned to delivery, compliance, and release readiness needs. 
The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in test data management, data engineering, governance, privacy, and automation in a complex enterprise environment. This role will drive modernization of TDM practices through automation-first and AI-enabled capabilities, while establishing standards, controls, and reusable services that improve engineering throughput, reduce delivery friction, and strengthen compliance and data protection across non-production environments.

**Responsibilities**

**Leadership, Strategy & Operating Model**

* Lead the enterprise Test Data Management function within EQE, including strategic direction, operating model execution, and organizational development.
* Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of managers, engineers, and test data specialists across multiple groups supporting segment and enterprise needs.
* Oversee a distributed organization of **50+ associates** and create clear priorities, role clarity, and performance expectations.
* Partner with Quality Engineering, Engineering, Product, Architecture, DevOps, Infrastructure, Security, and Data teams to align TDM services with business and delivery priorities.
* Drive a scalable support model for segment TDM services across multiple portfolios and delivery teams.
* Promote a culture of quality, compliance, continuous improvement, and shared ownership of secure test data practices.

**Test Data Engineering & Management**

 

* Lead enterprise engineering and management of secure, scalable, and compliant test data solutions.
* Oversee delivery of core TDM capabilities, including:Test data provisioningSynthetic data generationData masking and obfuscationData de-identificationData quality enablementTest data automationData lifecycle managementEnvironment data coordination
* Ensure test data is available, fit for purpose, and aligned to quality engineering, release, and environment needs.
* Advance data engineering practices that improve the reliability, reusability, and speed of test data provisioning across delivery pipelines.
* Support complex testing needs across functional, integration, regression, end-to-end, and non-production validation use cases.

**AI-Enabled & Automation-First TDM**

 

* Drive **AI-enabled** and automation-first TDM strategies to improve speed, intelligence, scalability, and coverage of test data operations.
* Expand the use of AI and advanced automation for synthetic data generation, sensitive data detection, masking rule optimization, provisioning efficiency, and data quality insights.
* Integrate TDM automation into CI/CD and engineering workflows where applicable to reduce manual effort and increase release confidence.
* Partner with enterprise engineering and platform teams to modernize TDM tooling, workflows, and reusable patterns.
* Establish metrics to evaluate automation effectiveness, data readiness, cycle time reduction, and business value realization.

**Governance, Standards, Compliance & Privacy**

 

* Define and enforce enterprise TDM standards, governance, and operating policies.
* Ensure compliance with privacy, security, and regulatory requirements related to test data usage, storage, movement, masking, and de-identification.
* Oversee implementation of compliance and privacy controls for non-production data usage.
* Establish standards for secure handling of production-like data in test environments.
* Partner with security, risk, privacy, and compliance stakeholders to maintain appropriate controls and audit readiness.
* Promote consistent governance for test data access, retention, refresh, lineage, and lifecycle management.

**Delivery Enablement & Stakeholder Partnership**

 

* Enable delivery teams through timely, compliant, and high-quality test data services that improve engineering throughput and release readiness.
* Partner with segment quality engineering leaders and application teams to understand demand patterns and align TDM support to delivery roadmaps.
* Coordinate across environments and shared services to reduce delays related to data setup, refresh, and availability.
* Influence engineering and quality practices that improve testability, environment readiness, and quality outcomes.
* Collaborate with enterprise enablement and platform teams to standardize capabilities and reduce duplication.

**Metrics, Governance & Continuous Improvement**

 

* Define and monitor KPIs related to test data availability, provisioning speed, automation adoption, compliance adherence, data quality, and operational efficiency.
* Use data and insights to identify risks, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities across TDM services.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce manual work, increase data reliability, and improve customer satisfaction.
* Provide clear reporting and operational transparency to senior leadership and stakeholders.
* Build maturity roadmaps for enterprise TDM capabilities and measure progress against defined outcomes.

**Use your skills to make an impact**
=====================================

**Required Qualifications**

 

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or any technology related degree or equivalent experience.
* **10+ years** of experience in quality engineering, test data management, data engineering, software engineering, or related technical disciplines.
* **5+ years** of leadership experience managing enterprise-scale technology teams, including managers and geographically distributed associates.
* Experience leading or scaling **test data management**, data engineering, or quality engineering functions in a large enterprise environment.
* Demonstrated success building and operating secure, scalable, and compliant test data solutions.
* Experience with key TDM capabilities such as data provisioning, masking, obfuscation, de-identification, synthetic data generation, and lifecycle management.
* Strong understanding of privacy, security, and compliance considerations for test data in regulated environments.
* Experience driving automation and process modernization across engineering or quality workflows.
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills, with the ability to influence across engineering, quality, data, and business organizations.
* Experience working in Agile and DevOps environments and supporting modern software delivery practices.

**Preferred Qualifications**

 

* Experience in healthcare, payer/insurance, or another highly regulated industry.
* Experience supporting enterprise quality engineering or platform enablement organizations.
* Familiarity with test data management platforms, masking tools, synthetic data solutions, and data quality tooling.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms, distributed systems, APIs, CI/CD pipelines, and enterprise engineering platforms.
* Experience applying AI or machine learning capabilities to test data, quality engineering, or operational optimization.
* Familiarity with data governance, data retention, and environment management practices in large-scale enterprises.

**Success in this Role**

In this role, success will be measured by:

* Improved speed, reliability, and scalability of enterprise test data provisioning and support.
* Increased adoption of secure, compliant, and reusable TDM solutions across segments and teams.
* Reduced delivery delays caused by test data availability, quality, or environment coordination issues.
* Strong compliance with privacy, security, masking, and de-identification requirements.
* Measurable advancement in AI-enabled and automation-first TDM capabilities.
* Improved stakeholder satisfaction across Quality Engineering, Engineering, Product, and Delivery teams.
* Strong associate engagement, capability growth, and retention across the TDM organization.

new_roles.description:
**A Brief Overview** 
The Director of Quality, Safety, Accreditation and Policy provides strategic and operational leadership for clinical 
quality, patient safety, regulatory readiness, accreditation compliance, and organizational policy management 
across a large, complex medical center. The Director establishes priorities, ensures alignment across clinical and 
operational functions, and partners with physician, nursing, operational, and administrative executives to 
advance high reliability, continuous improvement, regulatory excellence, and patient-centered care. This position 
has accountability for the design, execution, and sustained performance of quality improvement, patient safety, 
accreditation, policy governance, performance measurement, and regulatory compliance programs. The Director 
translates organizational strategy into medical center-wide priorities, evaluates performance and risk, directs 
corrective action, and provides executive leaders with recommendations needed to achieve organizational goals 
and external standards. 
What You Will Do 

* Quality and Performance Improvement
* Establish and lead the organization's quality, safety, accreditation, and policy strategy in alignment with

organizational strategy and medical center priorities. 

* Set the performance improvement agenda and direct organization-wide and departmental initiatives,

including prioritization, resource allocation, accountability, and sustainability of results. 

* Establish performance expectations and governance for key quality indicators, publicly reported

measures, regulatory metrics, and improvement commitments; intervene when performance or 
compliance is at risk. 

* Facilitate data-driven improvement efforts using Lean, Six Sigma, PDSA, and other improvement

methodologies. 

* Own the integrity, interpretation, and executive communication of quality dashboards, scorecards, and

performance reporting, including recommendations for action and escalation. 

* Partner with physician and nursing leaders to improve clinical outcomes, reliability, equity, and patient

experience. 

* Exercise decision-making authority within the assigned portfolio and escalate material quality, safety,

regulatory, or accreditation risks to executive leadership and appropriate governance bodies. 

* Define accountability structures for leaders responsible for performance improvement plans and verify

that corrective actions produce sustained results. 

* Patient Safety
* Provide leadership for the patient safety program and establish expectations for a culture of safety, high

reliability, transparency, learning, and accountability 

* Direct governance for event reporting, root cause analyses, apparent cause analyses, and corrective

action plans; ensure timely escalation, leadership accountability, and validation that risk-reduction 
actions are effective and sustained. 

* In partnership with Risk and clinical loss control, monitor serious safety events, near misses, and highreliability

metrics. 

* Collaborate with risk management, infection prevention, and operational leaders on safety priorities.
* Integrate patient safety, infection prevention, clinical risk, quality improvement, and regulatory priorities

to reduce duplication, close gaps, and promote consistent practices across care settings. 

* Support implementation of evidence-based practices to reduce preventable harm.
* Accreditation and Regulatory Compliance
* Provide oversight of Joint Commission, DNV, CMS, state, and specialty accreditation readiness,

partnering with the designated accreditation leader who directs day-to-day readiness activities to include 
establishing priorities, assigning corrective actions, and escalating unresolved compliance risks. 

* Oversee organizational responses to survey findings and regulatory deficiencies, including corrective

action governance, evidence submission, validation of sustained compliance, and executive escalation; 
monitor regulatory changes and communicate implications to leadership; and partner with operational 
leaders to address gaps and sustain compliance. 

* Policy Management and Governance
* Lead policy governance and document control processes including standards for development, approval,

publication, review, exception management, and retirement. 

* Ensure policies remain current, evidence-based, and aligned with regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate policy review cycles and approvals with clinical, operational, legal, compliance, and executive

stakeholders.

Evaluate policy compliance trends and identify improvement opportunities. 

* Resolve or escalate cross-functional policy conflicts and ensure accountable leaders address material

gaps in policy implementation or adherence. 

* Maintain oversight of organizational policy standards and publication processes. Consistent with UH

policy governance structures, accreditation, compliance, legal, quality, and operational leaders 
collaborate to ensure policy adherence and regulatory alignment. 

* Academic Mission Support
* Collaborate with medical school leadership, residency and fellowship programs, and research leadership

to integrate quality, safety, and regulatory expectations into organizational programs. 

* Support quality and safety education for medical students, residents, fellows, and faculty.
* Leadership and Operations
* Establish departmental goals, operating plans, budgets, staffing models, and resource priorities; monitor

financial and operational performance and adjust plans as organizational needs change. 

* Build leadership capability and succession plans for quality, safety, accreditation, regulatory, policy, and

performance improvement professionals; hold direct reports accountable for measurable outcomes. 

* Serve as the quality and safety advisor to executive, physician, nursing, and operational leadership,

providing independent evaluation of performance, risk, regulatory exposure, and improvement priorities. 

* Present quality, safety, accreditation, regulatory, and policy performance to governing boards, executive

committees, and medical staff leadership; recommend decisions, investments, and corrective actions. 

* Chair or lead multidisciplinary governance committees focused on quality, accreditation, safety,

regulatory compliance, and policy, with authority to establish agendas, assign accountability, and 
escalate unresolved issues. 

* Negotiate priorities and resource needs across competing operational demands while protecting

regulatory compliance, patient safety, and organizational performance. 

* Represent the medical center in organization-wide councils and, as assigned, with external regulators,

accrediting organizations, professional associations, and community partners.

**Additional Responsibilities** 

* Performs other duties as assigned.
* Complies with all policies and standards.
* For specific duties and responsibilities, refer to documentation provided by the department during

orientation. 

* Must abide by all requirements to safely and securely maintain Protected Health Information (PHI) for

our patients. Annual training, the UH Code of Conduct and UH policies and procedures are in place to 
address appropriate use of PHI in the workplace.

**Education Qualifications** 

* Bachelor's Degree in Healthcare Administration, Nursing, Public Health, Business Administration, or

related field (Required) 

* Master's Degree in Healthcare Administration, Nursing, Public Health, Business Administration, or related

field Preferred (Preferred)

**Experience Qualifications** 

* 8+ years of experience in healthcare quality, patient safety, accreditation, regulatory, and clinical

leadership experience with several years in people management capacity[ (Required) 

* Experience within an academic medical center, integrated delivery system, or large healthcare

organization. (Required) 
• • Experience with Joint Commission/DNV survey leadership. • Experience overseeing policy governance. 

* Experience leading multidisciplinary teams, influencing senior and executive leaders, managing

organizational change, and sustaining measurable results across complex operations. • Experience 
presenting to governing boards, executive committees, medical staff leadership, or comparable senior 
governance groups. • Experience managing budgets, staffing plans, and resource allocation for a 
complex function or department. (Preferred

**Licenses and Certifications** 
• • Certified Professional in Healthcare Quality (CPHQ) • Certified Professional in Patient Safety (CPPS) • 
Lean Six Sigma Green Belt, Black Belt, or equivalent • Healthcare accreditation or regulatory certification 
(Preferred)

**Physical Demands**

* Walking Occasionally
* Sitting Constantly
* Lifting Rarely 20 lbs

### **About the Role**

A small, early-stage AI company serving manufacturers is seeking a Head of Operations / COO to work closely with the founders. You will own day-to-day business operations and help build scalable customer delivery and supply chain processes.

### **What You'll Do**

* Lead end-to-end operations, including customer onboarding, order execution, supplier and carrier coordination, and issue resolution.
* Build processes, metrics, and playbooks that help a lean team serve more manufacturers.
* Partner with engineering to identify operational workflows that AI agents should automate.
* Manage supplier and freight operations, vendor relationships, and service quality.
* Hire and lead the operations team as the business grows.
* Work with the founders on planning, finance, and company priorities.

### **What We're Looking For**

* Six to ten years of relevant experience, including senior operations leadership as a Head of Operations, COO, VP or Director of Operations, or in a similar role.
* Hands-on experience in supply chain, procurement, logistics, or manufacturing operations.
* Experience at an early-stage startup or on a small team, with the ability to build processes from the ground up and stay hands-on.
* Strong numerical, systems, and process-design skills.
* Experience in CPG, food, supplements, cosmetics, chemicals, or related manufacturing, or in freight brokerage or 3PL operations, is helpful.
* Past founder or early startup experience is a plus.

### **Location**

On-site in San Francisco, California, five days per week. Candidates may relocate within the United States.

new_roles.title: Sr. Manager, Quality Assurance
new_roles.description:
**Company Summary: PuraGraft, a Young Innovations Company**

PuraGraft represents the leading manufacturers of biomaterial solutions for bone and tissue regeneration. No single material can suit all medical requirements and indications. However, through PuraGraft® you have access to the widest choices of products.

At Young Innovations, we foster a dynamic environment where team members make an impact every day as part of a collaborative, inclusive culture. Together, we serve the dental profession and their patients, united in our mission of achieving a Lifetime of Oral Health™

We embrace diverse perspectives and encourage bold thinking, challenging traditional approaches with a bias for action. Whether you’re looking to expand your skills or grow your career, Young is here to support your goals and continuous learning. At Young, YOU are at the core of what we do.

**Position Overview:**

Reporting to the VP Quality Regulatory Affairs, the Sr. Manager, Quality Assurance will be tasked with ensuring Quality standards are met or exceeded in all facets of the multi-site operation. He/she will partner internally in the development and implementation of new or adjusted quality standards, policies, and procedures, as required at Kingwood, TX and Scottsdale, AZ.

**You’ll like this role if:**

* You enjoy leading a team, solving complex quality challenges, and turning data into practical improvements. You take ownership of compliance and thrive in a hands-on role supporting quality standards across multiple sites.

**Why You’ll Love Working Here:**

* Medium sized company – not too big, not too small – just enough to get things done and see your impact.
* Did we say benefits? Full medical, dental, vision, 401k, parental leave, paid holidays, paid time off, short & long term disability insurance, employee assistance program, and more!
* Lead and inspire a dedicated team, build meaningful relationships, and help your employees grow and succeed.

**Who you’ll work with:**

* You’ll report to the VP of Quality & Regulatory Affairs and lead Quality Associates supporting our Kingwood, TX and Scottsdale, AZ operations.
* You’ll partner closely with QRA, Sourcing, Distribution, and Production teams to strengthen quality systems and drive continuous improvement.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Act as the site’s Sr. Quality and Compliance Leader, and when necessary, as the site’s Designated Management Representative to ensure compliance with all regulatory, corporate and facility requirements.
* Ensure compliance of two sites.
* Ensure outstanding Quality System performance via monitoring and measuring of process performance, and driving any appropriate action, including issuing and follow-up on activities required for sourcing, warehousing, and distributing pharmaceuticals.
* Supervise & Manage Quality Associates and develop culture of collaboration and cross-functional success within the department and business.
* Reviews and monitors Quality metrics and reports trends, to determine if there is a need to escalate issues to the management.
* Perform, review and monitor the Quality Management processes which include but is not limited to:
 + Ensure compliance with FDA, DEA and BOP requirements, including DSCSA traceability of pharmaceuticals.
 + Oversee Regulatory activities associated with distribution licensing, drug distribution reports, and permits for warehousing and distribution of controlled substances.
 + inspection and product release, label approval, calibration, warehousing controls, record retention, document control, training, control of non-conforming product, quarantined Products, control of access and drugs storage, including temperature monitoring.
 + Host and manage internal and external audits. Ensure the site’s readiness for assessments and lead implementation of corrective actions.
 + Effectively assess processes and identify opportunities for improvement.
 + Review, Analyze and Report Statistical findings through critical thought and storytelling of key findings and opportunities to all levels within a matrixed organization.
 + Partner with other departments to identify critical to quality metrics, and support the operationalization of monitoring and management to deliver improved performance across processes.
 + Create effective and compelling visual materials/presentations that support the process/product improvement impact to the organization and adequately represent the impact to quality, cost and time.
 + Define, track, and monitor key success measures associated with Quality Management Systems. Successfully deploy and support change management and appropriate training plans.
* Manage document control functions, including creation, review, and approval of procedures, work instructions and all other documentation for the Quality System.
* Manage the complaint handling system, including trending and review to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Manage the training of the Site, by maintaining the training log, tracking training completion of training by site personnel, creating training content and hosting group training as needed.
* Develop and host the Quarterly Management Review
* Manage the Recall process, from notification, tracking responses & expenses, reporting, and closure.
* Develop, refine, and/or maintain quality standards, policies, and procedures for the facility, including identifying, recommending, and fully implementing changes, in partnership with corporate QRA and local operations teams. Other duties as assigned

**What You’ll Bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in technical field.
* Minimum of 3 Years of experience managing manufacturing and/or distribution of pharmaceuticals.
* Minimum of 3 Years of experience having direct responsibility for managing a Quality group.
* Direct experience managing FDA or DEA Inspections.
* Demonstrated proficiency in verbal and written communication in English, with the ability to convey information clearly, accurately, and professionally across all levels of the organization.

**Travel Requirements**

* Up to 15%

**Work Environment:**

**Office Environment**

This position is based in an office environment and is primarily sedentary in nature. It requires regular use of standard office equipment, including computers, phones, photocopiers, scanners, filing cabinets, and fax machines. Some roles may involve wearing a headset and sustained computer use for 8 or more hours per day. Employees may be required to sit, stand, or walk for extended periods, and occasional bending, lifting, or carrying items up to 50 pounds may be necessary.

**Manufacturing/Distribution Environment**

This position operates in a manufacturing plant environment. The role routinely involves working around machinery, equipment, and moving mechanical parts. The facility may be subject to varying temperatures, loud noise levels, and airborne particles such as dust or chemical fumes, depending on the area of the plant. This role may require periods of standing, sitting, or walking throughout the workday. Occasional bending, lifting, or carrying items up to 50 pounds may be necessary.

Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus. While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is regularly required to sit; use hands to finger, handle, control, or feel; reach with hands and arms and talk. Hearing abilities required for this environment include being able to clearly hear and respond to audible alarms, production equipment, forklifts, and other machinery to maintain a safe work environment. Individuals must be able to distinguish and understand verbal communication including instructions, safety warnings, and team discussions, sometimes in an environment with moderate to high background noise.

new_roles.description:

**Description**
---------------

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

The **Director, Manufacturing Engineering** provides functional and strategic leadership for the manufacturing engineering organization, accountable for process capability, producibility, and product quality across production programs. This role leads a team of managers and engineers responsible for developing, deploying, and continuously improving manufacturing, test, and related industrial engineering processes to meet safety, quality, delivery, cost, and people objectives in **Baltimore, MD**.

Key Responsibilities

* **Functional & People Leadership**
 + Lead and develop a high‑performing manufacturing engineering organization, including managers, engineers, and supporting staff.
 + Define and maintain functional standards, methods, tools, and best practices for manufacturing engineering across the site or business.
 + Recruit, develop, and retain talent; drive succession planning, leadership development, and engagement/inclusion activities.
 + Provide regular coaching, performance feedback, and career development for managers and engineers.

* **Manufacturing Engineering Ownership**
 + Own manufacturing engineering processes from new product introduction through sustainment, ensuring robust process controls, standard work, and documented work instructions.
 + Direct the creation and maintenance of MBOMs, routings, work instructions, tooling, and strategies that enable safe, efficient, and high‑quality production.
 + Drive producibility into designs by partnering with Design Engineering early in the lifecycle; ensure effective transition to production and rate readiness.
 + Establish and manage key performance indicators (yields, scrap, rework, cycle time, labor efficiency) and drive continuous improvement using data‑driven methods.

* **Operations, Quality, and Continuous Improvement**
 + Partner closely with Operations, Quality & Mission Excellence, and Supply Chain to ensure stable processes and timely resolution of production issues.
 + Oversee manufacturing engineering participation in MRB and nonconformance disposition; ensure effective root‑cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions.
 + Champion initiatives to improve safety, quality, delivery, and cost.
 + Lead manufacturing engineering support to factory readiness, capacity planning, and rate ramp‑ups.

* **Program, Financial, and Strategic Management**
 + Align functional objectives, resources, and priorities with program and business needs; balance near‑term execution with long‑term capability development.
 + Partner with Program Management and Business Management to support bids, proposals, and program execution, including manufacturing scope, risk, and cost/schedule inputs.
 + Own manufacturing engineering budgets (labor, capital, and expense) and apply sound financial management.
 + Develop and execute technology roadmaps and capital investment plans for manufacturing processes, equipment, and facilities.
* **Compliance, Governance, and Stakeholder Management**
 + Ensure manufacturing engineering processes comply with regulatory requirements, customer standards, and internal procedures.
 + Represent manufacturing engineering in internal and external reviews, audits, and customer engagements.
 + Build strong relationships with sector/site leadership, program teams, and functional peers to drive alignment and resolve cross‑functional constraints.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related discipline with 10 or more years of relevant experience; OR a Master’s degree in Engineering or a related discipline with 8 or more years of relevant experience.
* 3 or more years of functional management experience leading organizations of at least 100 employees.
* Progressive leadership experience in manufacturing/production, operations, program management, testing, or a related area, including direct leadership of engineers and/or first‑line managers.
* Demonstrated experience in manufacturing or production engineering supporting complex hardware (e.g., aerospace, defense, electronics, or similar).
* Proven track record of improving manufacturing and test processes, yields, cycle times, and product quality using data and metrics.
* Working knowledge of manufacturing process controls, quality systems, and relevant industry/regulatory standards.
* Demonstrated financial acumen including budgets, rates, and cost management
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to clearly present technical and operational content to leadership and customers.
* **U.S. citizenship** and an ability to obtain U.S. Government **Secret** security clearance or greater; OR DoE equivalent or greater

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced degree in Engineering, Engineering Management, Business Administration, or related field.
* Experience in a Director or senior manager role leading a manufacturing engineering or test engineering organization in an aerospace/defense or similarly regulated environment.
* Experience working across multiple disciplines (design, manufacturing, and test engineering) with a strong focus on product development, producibility, and transition to production.
* Hands‑on experience with continuous improvement frameworks
* Experience managing capital equipment roadmaps and facilities upgrades to support long‑term manufacturing capacity and capability.
* Proven ability to build and develop high‑performing teams, including succession planning, leadership development, and engagement initiatives.
* Experience supporting proposals and customer reviews, including articulation of manufacturing engineering approaches, risks, and mitigations.
* Experience working in a matrixed organization, balancing program demands with functional standards and development needs.

new_roles.title: Director of Continuous Improvement & Business System Development
new_roles.description:
Skybound Service Partners is a national platform dedicated to partnering with leading commercial roofing and building services companies. We invest in exceptional teams, proven businesses, and long-term relationships to help our partner companies grow stronger and deliver greater value to their customers. At Skybound, we offer more than a job, we offer the opportunity to build a meaningful career within a network that prioritizes people, performance, and sustainable success.

Skybound Service Partners is a private equity-backed commercial roofing platform of five regional brands, and we're continuing to grow through acquisition. Each brand keeps its own name, leadership, and P&L. Skybound provides the shared support and systems that help them grow faster together. Our work happens on rooftops, on jobsites, and in trucks, not on a production line.

**The Role** 
We're looking for a builder to take the Skybound Business System (SBS) from concept to a working system across every brand. You'll partner with the executive team to define the framework, build the tools, and deploy them. You'll also lead continuous improvement projects from start to finish, focused on standard work, waste reduction, and productivity. The brands own their businesses, so this role leads through influence, not mandate.

**What You'll Do**

* Partner with the executive team to define SBS principles, tools, and operating cadence, starting from what already works inside the brands.
* Own multi-site CI roadmaps tied to business priorities, with the governance and KPIs to track adoption and results.
* Drive CI projects from start to implementation, including standard work for our core processes across all brands.
* Embed daily management, visual metrics, and structured problem solving at every site, adapted for field crews and project-based work.
* Lead kaizen events and training, and build a certification path so internal practitioners can run improvement work on their own.
* Bring SBS fundamentals into newly acquired brands as part of each integration, while respecting what those businesses already do well.
* Partner with IT on technology, including AI and automation, to reduce manual work and improve consistency.

**What It Takes**

* **Builder, not just an operator.** There's no playbook waiting for you. You've built a system where none existed, and a blank page energizes you.
* **Influences without authority.** You earn adoption by making leaders more successful, and you know what needs a common standard and what should stay local.
* **Credible with leadership and on the roof.** You're as effective with the executive team as you are with superintendents, foremen, and estimators.
* **Teacher first.** You measure success by how many leaders can run a kaizen without you.
* **Results over ceremony.** Every improvement ties to cycle time, quality, cash, or margin.
* **Owns outcomes.** When something stalls, you say so, find out why, and fix it or stop it.
* **Hands-on with technology.** You're comfortable building an AI or automation prototype yourself before handing it to IT.

**Qualifications**

*Required*

* 10–20 years of experience in operations and continuous improvement, including roles with direct responsibility for results
* A proven track record of leading large-scale process mapping and standard work rollouts
* Experience building a CI function or business system where none existed
* Bachelor's degree
* Must live near a major airport (Eastern or Central time zone preferred) and be willing to travel heavily during initial rollouts, settling to under 50%

*Preferred*

* CI leadership in field service, service operations, construction, or another service or project-based business
* Hands-on experience leading (not just participating in) a lean business system rollout, such as the Danaher Business System, Fortive Business System, or similar
* Experience rolling out a business system in newly acquired businesses
* Lean or Six Sigma certification; equivalent hands-on rollout experience is valued equally
* Advanced degree

**What Success Looks Like in Year One**

* SBS principles, operating cadence, and core tools agreed with leadership and launched at pilot sites
* Standard work established for our core processes across all five brands
* Measurable gains in cycle time, quality, and margin, validated by finance
* AI and automation tools piloted to reduce manual work
* A first group of internal practitioners trained and running improvement work on their own

new_roles.title: Americas Procurement Director, External Manufacturing
new_roles.description:
**Americas Procurement Director, External Manufacturing**
=========================================================

HUNT VALLEY, MD, US, 21031

You may know McCormick as a leader in herbs, spices, seasonings, and condiments – and we’re only getting started. At McCormick, we’re always looking for new people to bring their unique flavor to our team.

McCormick employees – all 14,000 of us across the world – are what makes this company a great place to work.

 

We are looking to hire an **Americas Procurement Director, External Manufacturing** immediately in a Hybrid (50/50) capacity at our Global Headquarters in Hunt Valley, Maryland.

 

**What We Bring To The Table:**

The best people deserve the best rewards. In addition to the benefits you’d expect from a global leader (401k, health insurance, paid time off, etc.) we also offer:

* Competitive compensation

* Career growth opportunities

* Flexibility and Support for Diverse Life Stages and Choices

 

**Position Overview**
 
Leads the commercial strategy, supplier relationships, and performance management for the Americas external manufacturing network, including co-manufacturers, co-packers, and strategic third-party manufacturing partners.
 
Accountable for delivering safe, compliant, reliable, cost-competitive, and scalable supply in support of business growth, innovation, customer service, and profitability objectives. Leads a procurement team and partners closely with Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Quality, Food Safety, Regulatory, R&D, Finance, Legal, and Commercial teams to deliver total value, manage risk, and strengthen supplier capability.

 

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develops and executes the Americas external manufacturing procurement strategy, including supplier segmentation, network optimization, make-buy analysis, capacity strategy, sourcing, and long-term value creation.
* Leads complex commercial negotiations and contracting, including manufacturing service agreements, pricing, capacity commitments, service levels, change control, risk allocation, and supplier exit provisions.
* Leads strategic supplier relationship management, including executive engagement, supplier scorecards, quarterly business reviews, corrective-action plans, and joint productivity and innovation initiatives.
* Ensures supply assurance and business continuity by identifying and mitigating supplier, capacity, quality, financial, geographic, and operational risks. Leads commercial response and recovery plans for material supplier disruptions.
* Partners with Quality, Food Safety, Regulatory, Manufacturing, Planning, R&D, Finance, and Legal to support commercialization, product transitions, compliance, supplier qualification, and operational performance.
* Leads annual operating plan, forecasting, standard-cost, productivity, inflation-mitigation, and financial performance management for the external manufacturing portfolio.
* Leads, develops, and retains a high-performing procurement team. Drives change management, capability development, process improvement, and adoption of data-driven procurement practices.
 

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Supply Chain, Business, Finance, Accounting or applicable field of study required.
* 10+ years of progressive procurement, supply chain, operations, or strategic sourcing experience required.
* 5+ years of people leadership and/or leadership of complex cross-functional teams required.
* Experience managing strategic supplier relationships, complex commercial negotiations, and significant spend or P&L impact required.
* Experience in external manufacturing, or a similarly complex outsourced operations environment required.
* Strong financial acumen, including total cost of ownership, cost modeling, forecasting, productivity, and risk management required.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior internal stakeholders and executive-level supplier partners. Strong negotiation, communication, change leadership, conflict resolution, and decision-making skills required.
* Strategic thinking; supplier relationship management; contract management; analytical and problem-solving capability; project and change management; customer focus; collaboration; accountability; agility; continuous improvement; and inclusive people leadership.
 

#LI-CG1

 

**As a general policy, McCormick does not offer employment visa sponsorships upon hire or in the future.**

McCormick & Company is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

 

===

 

Base Salary: $140,500 - $239,000

Base salary compensation will be determined based on factors such as geographic location, skills, education, experience for this role, and/or internal equity of our current employees as part of any final offer. This position is also eligible to participate in McCormick’s Incentive Bonus (MIB) Plan. In addition to a competitive compensation package, permanent employees of McCormick are eligible for our extensive Total Rewards programs that include:

* Comprehensive health plans covering medical, vision, dental, life and disability benefits

* Family-friendly benefits such as paid parental leave, fertility benefits, Employee Assistance Program, and caregiver support

* Retirement and investment programs including 401(k) and profit-sharing plans

**WHY WORK AT MCCORMICK?**
--------------------------

As a McCormick employee you’ll be empowered to focus on more than your individual responsibilities. You’ll have the opportunity to be part of something bigger than yourself—to have a say in where the company is going and how it’s growing.

Between our passion for flavor, our 130-year history of leadership and integrity, the competitive and comprehensive benefits we offer, and our culture, which is built on respect and opportunities for growth, there are many reasons to join us at McCormick.

**Nearest Major Market:** Baltimore

new_roles.title: Director of Operations
new_roles.description:
**Director of Operations** 
**Micro-Tronics, Inc. | Tempe, AZ**

Full-Time | Exempt 
Shift: Monday-Friday, 6:00 am to 4:00 pm

**About Micro-Tronics**
=======================

Micro-Tronics, Inc. is a precision aerospace manufacturing company committed to operational excellence, quality, and continuous improvement. We are seeking a results-driven Director of Operations to lead our manufacturing operations and drive performance across production, quality, supply chain, maintenance, and workforce planning. This role is instrumental in delivering customer commitments, achieving revenue objectives, improving operational efficiency, and fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

**Position Summary**
====================

The Director of Operations oversees daily plant operations with primary accountability for reducing past-due orders, improving manufacturing efficiency, and achieving company revenue targets while maintaining the highest standards of quality and safety. This position provides strategic and operational leadership across manufacturing operations, labor planning, production scheduling, budgeting, and continuous improvement initiatives. The Director of Operations aligns production capacity, scheduling, and shipments with customer commitments and business objectives while driving corrective actions when performance falls short.

**Key Interactions and Relationships**
======================================

Internal: Senior Management, Assembly, Machining, Elastomer Manufacturing, Quality Control, Maintenance, Supply Chain, Human Resources.

External: Customers, Suppliers, Regulatory Agencies and Governing Bodies.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Supervise and manage plant personnel, including recruiting, training, coaching, and performance management.
* Plan, organize, direct, and manage daily operations to reduce past-due orders, improve manufacturing efficiency, and achieve revenue objectives.
* Develop and improve manufacturing processes to increase throughput and labor productivity while reducing cycle times, downtime, scrap, and rework.
* Oversee production scheduling, maintenance, and logistics to ensure customer delivery commitments are achieved.
* Monitor past-due orders, prioritize recovery efforts, and eliminate material and capacity constraints.
* Manage operational budgets and expenses.
* Ensure all products meet customer requirements, regulatory standards, and company quality objectives.
* Maintain a safe work environment through enforcement of company policies, procedures, and OSHA requirements.
* Manage operational budgets and expenses while aligning production and shipment performance with monthly and quarterly revenue goals.
* Establish and maintain effective controls over capital expenditures, operating expenses, staffing, and labor costs.
* Maintain and review operational scorecards and KPIs while coordinating corrective actions with Quality, Supply Chain, Finance, and Human Resources.
* Drive resolution of safety incidents, customer returns, nonconformances, production scrap, inventory concerns, and supplier performance issues.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
=====================================

* Operational efficiency and productivity
* Product quality and compliance
* On-time delivery and backlog reduction
* Revenue growth and budget management
* Safety and risk performance
* Scrap, nonconformance, and customer return reduction
* Inventory accuracy and customer satisfaction

**Qualifications**
==================

**Education, Licenses and Certifications**

A bachelor's degree in engineering, manufacturing, business administration, or a related field is required.

**Leadership Skills / Soft Skills**

* Excellent leadership and communication skills.
* Strong problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to foster a positive and productive work environment.
* Mentorship and team-building skills.
* Adaptability and a continuous improvement mindset.

**Individual Contributor Knowledge and Skills**

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
* Experience with ERP/MRP systems.
* Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Ability to analyze operational data and make informed decisions.
* Knowledge of industry regulations and compliance requirements.

**Physical Requirements**
=========================

This is an active position requiring the ability to:

* Stand and walk for extended periods.
* Sit for extended periods as business needs require.
* Operate forklifts, scissor lifts, and other material handling equipment.
* Lift and move up to **50 pounds**.
* Work throughout manufacturing environments, including elevated work areas and outdoor conditions when necessary.
* Wear required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).

**Our Values**
==============

* **Being Accountable** – Taking ownership of responsibilities, following through on commitments, acting with integrity, and producing quality results.
* **Being Collaborative** – Working respectfully and effectively with others, sharing knowledge, communicating openly, and contributing to team success.
* **Being Empowered** – Demonstrating initiative, solving problems proactively, embracing continuous improvement, and making informed decisions within the scope of the position

**Benefits**
============

At Micro-Tronics Inc., we recognize how important your career and benefits are to you and your family. We offer a full suite of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, short- and long-term disability coverage, accident insurance, critical illness insurance, basic and supplemental life insurance, employee assistance plan, retirement savings and matching, and other developmental opportunities. We are committed to supporting the way you live and work.

**Apply Today**
===============

If you are passionate about operational leadership, manufacturing excellence, continuous improvement, and driving business results, we encourage you to apply and become part of the Micro-Tronics team.

**Micro-Tronics is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status. Applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to complete the application process may contact Human Resources.**

**This position requires access to information subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Employment is contingent upon the applicant being a “U.S. person” as defined by ITAR (22 CFR §120.15), which includes U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, refugees, or asylees, as required by U.S. export control laws**.

**The role**
------------

**Build our future together:**

At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. We are seeking an Executive Director, Manufacturing IT Planning & Strategy (Digital Transformation) to join our IOPS IT organization, leading the planning and governance behind our digital and automation transformation supporting GMP operations. Sitting within the Plan function of IOPS IT’s Plan-Build-Run operating model, you will set the direction, governance, and investment strategy that Build and Run teams deliver and sustain — partnering with corporate IT and cross-functional leaders across the enterprise to drive fast, reliable, and compliant technology decisions at scale. This position offers the opportunity to contribute to a fast-growing, science-driven organization making a meaningful difference to patients worldwide.

 
 

**When & where:**

* Location: Troy, New York United States
* Work model: 8am - 4:30pm, onsite
* Travel percentage: 25% global to other manufacturing facilities
 

 

**Discover your role:**

* Establish technology governance, portfolio management, and demand management anchored in enterprise architecture standards, driving business and technology transformation through full portfolio visibility and fast technology decisions.
* Lead large-scale IT and digital transformation programs, resolving constraints and redirecting priorities to deliver business outcomes.
* Successfully take modern, cutting-edge technologies from plan to implementation, with reliability and security built in.
* Deliver technology solutions in cGMP pharmaceutical or biotech manufacturing, aligning compliance, validation, and data integrity with every technology decision.
* Communicate technology strategy into funded investment plans and manage budgets with a clear view of long-term operating impact.
* Utilize interpersonal skills to collaborate across all organizational levels.
 

 

**This role requires:**

* Bachelor’s degree in IT or a related field and have 18+ years of experience in IT and business operations/transformations, including a cGMP biotechnology/pharmaceutical environment. An equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered.
 

 
 

Does this sound like you? Apply now to take your first step towards living the Regeneron Way! We are committed to building a workplace with an inclusive culture. Regeneron is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief (or lack thereof), sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, civil status, pregnancy or parental status, age, disability, nationality, citizenship status, ethnic or national origin, membership of the Traveler community, familial status, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. Where required, we will provide reasonable accommodation to applicants with known disabilities or chronic illnesses during the recruitment process, unless such accommodation would impose undue hardship.

Where necessary, we disclose salary ranges for roles in all countries in which we operate. The final offer will be determined within the relevant range based on the country of employment, specific role level, and your skills and experience. In some countries, collective bargaining agreements (CBAs) may apply and influence certain elements of pay or benefits. Regeneron offers a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package which may include, depending on country and role: annual bonuses or other incentive plans, equity awards, pension or retirement benefits, 401(k) company match, health and wellness programs, fitness centers, insurance benefits (e.g. medical, dental, vision, life and disability), paid time off, and family support benefits. For additional information about Regeneron benefits in the U.S., please visit https://careers.regeneron.com/en/working-at-regeneron/total-rewards/. For other locations, additional information will be provided during the recruitment process. If you have any questions, please speak with your recruiter.

 
 

Please be advised that at Regeneron, we believe we do our best work when we are together. For that reason, many roles are required to be performed on‑site. Please speak with your recruiter and hiring manager for more information about on‑site expectations for your role and location.

 
 

As part of the recruitment process, certain background checks may be conducted in accordance with the laws of the country where the position is based. The purpose of such checks is to verify certain information prior to the commencement of employment such as identity, right to work and educational qualifications.

new_roles.description:
**Work Schedule**

Standard (Mon-Fri)

**Environmental Conditions**

Office

**Job Description**

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

**LOCATION**: Currently tied to Morrisville, NC (may be open to other locations). Relocation assistance is NOT provided.

* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.
* Must be able to pass a comprehensive background check, which includes a drug screening.

**DESCRIPTION**:

As a Senior Director of Operations at Thermo Fisher Scientific, you'll manage complex manufacturing operations while driving strategic growth and operational excellence. This key leadership role involves directing production of high-quality products in regulated environments while ensuring exceptional customer service and compliance. You'll optimize end-to-end operations, implement continuous improvement initiatives, and develop high-performing teams aligned with our mission of enabling customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer.

Working closely with cross-functional partners, you'll establish and execute strategic plans, drive productivity and efficiency improvements, and support a culture focused on quality, safety and customer success. This role requires strong business acumen to manage P&L responsibilities while scaling operations to meet growing demand. You'll support our PPI (Practical Process Improvement) business system and 4i values - Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement - while developing talent and building engaged, collaborative teams.

**REQUIREMENTS**:

* Advanced Degree plus 6 years of experience, or Bachelor's Degree plus 8 years of experience in operations leadership in regulated manufacturing environments
* Preferred Fields of Study: Engineering, Chemistry, Biology, Business or related technical/scientific field
* Advanced training in continuous improvement methodologies (Six Sigma, Lean)
* Demonstrated P&L management and operational excellence experience at scale
* Strong working knowledge of cGMP, FDA, and other relevant quality/regulatory requirements
* Experience leading and developing large, multi-functional teams
* Experience implementing continuous improvement and lean manufacturing methodologies
* Strong business acumen and analytical capabilities
* Effective communication and influence skills across all organizational levels
* Ability to implement change and deliver results in matrix environments
* Experience with ERP systems and manufacturing technologies
* Strong project management capabilities
* Strategic mindset with ability to balance short and long-term priorities
* Experience in customer/client relationship management
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities
* Ability to travel 50-75% as required
* Change management and transformation experience
* Cross-functional collaboration and influence skills
* Financial planning and budget management expertise

We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus scheme, healthcare, company 401k, and a range of employee benefits! Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation.

Thermo Fisher Scientific is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided a reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform critical job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request an accommodation.

new_roles.title: Seating Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
**Seating Plant Manager**

**Position Summary**
====================

DARRAN is a family-owned furniture manufacturer based in High Point, North Carolina, creating thoughtfully designed furniture for 50 years. Our work brings together craftsmanship, innovation, and a commitment to quality, supported by people who take pride in what they build.
===================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

We are seeking a Production Manager over our Seating Operations to guide our seating manufacturing operation and support its continued growth. This leadership role brings together people, processes, and craftsmanship to build a strong team and deliver exceptional products. The ideal candidate leads by example, develops others, and creates an environment where accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement are part of everyday work.


**Management and People Leadership**
====================================

* Direct and supervise seating department employees, assign work, communicate daily priorities, and hold employees accountable for meeting expectations.
* Set clear expectations for productivity, quality, attendance, conduct, and safe work practices. Ensure employees understand their responsibilities and department goals.
* Monitor individual and team performance daily, including output, work quality, efficiency, attendance, and adherence to established procedures. Identify concerns and address them promptly.
* Provide ongoing coaching and timely feedback. Establish improvement expectations, document follow-up, and verify that required improvements are achieved and sustained.
* Administer and document disciplinary actions in partnership with HR and in accordance with company policy. Clearly communicate the concern, required correction, and consequences of continued issues.
* Complete annual performance reviews and provide accurate, specific feedback supported by documented performance observations.
* Partner with HR on hiring and employee matters. Coordinate onboarding and training, assess employee skills, and identify development and cross-training needs.
* Apply company policies consistently, address employee concerns respectfully, and maintain clear communication with employees, HR, and senior operations leadership.

**Production**
==============

* Lead daily production startup and ensure teams, materials, and priorities are ready at the beginning of each shift.
* Manage production flow across frame building, cutting, sewing, upholstering, and final assembly to keep work on schedule.
* Partner with senior operations leadership to review daily objectives, constraints, and priorities.
* Drive results across output, delivery performance, labor utilization, overtime, quality, and production flow.
* Develop and improve standard operating procedures and processes that increase throughput and reduce bottlenecks.
* Coordinate with outside and original-equipment suppliers to maintain production capacity and quality standards while expanding internal capabilities.
* Collaborate with engineering and product development on patterns, production readiness, and the launch of new seating collections.
* Establish, maintain, and enforce quality checks and corrective actions.
* Coordinate maintenance needs, execute safety programs, and reinforce safe work practices throughout the operation.
* Advance shop-floor organization and housekeeping practices that support a structured, clean, and efficient workplace.

**How Success Is Measured**
===========================

Success is measured by consistent people leadership and department results against goals established with senior operations leadership. Performance is evaluated through production and quality reports, employee performance records, training progress, and completion of corrective actions.

* People management and accountability: Employees understand their goals and responsibilities. Performance and attendance concerns are addressed promptly, company policies are applied consistently, and coaching and disciplinary actions are documented with HR.
* Performance improvement: Individual and team results are monitored regularly. Employees receive specific feedback, improvement expectations and follow-up dates are documented, and progress is verified. Annual reviews are completed on time.
* Employee development: New employees complete assigned training, demonstrated skills meet job requirements, and cross-training improves coverage across seating operations.
* Production and delivery: Actual output and on-time completion meet established targets. Bottlenecks and schedule delays are identified early, communicated, and addressed.
* Quality: Products meet established standards. Defects, rework, and recurring quality issues are tracked, and corrective actions produce sustained improvement.
* Labor and operational efficiency: Labor utilization and overtime remain within established expectations. Process improvements reduce avoidable downtime and improve production flow.
* Safety and workplace organization: Safe work practices and housekeeping standards are consistently enforced. Hazards and incidents are reported promptly, and assigned corrective actions are completed by their due dates.
* Communication and follow-through: Priorities, staffing concerns, and production risks are communicated promptly to the appropriate partners. Assigned actions and production readiness milestones are completed on time.

**Qualifications**
==================

* 10+ years of upholstery, pattern, and assembly experience and 5+ years of running an upholstery operation.
* High school diploma or GED required.
* Strong reading, writing, math, analysis, comprehension, administrative, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to set clear priorities, manage and hold people accountable, monitor performance, document personnel matters, and collaborate across operations, HR, engineering, product development, and suppliers.
* A practical, continuous-improvement mindset with a strong commitment to safety, quality, delivery, and respectful people leadership.

**Physical Requirements and Work Environment**
==============================================

This is an on-site role in an active manufacturing environment. The position requires excellent vision, hearing/listening, and clear speech; hand and finger dexterity; lifting and carrying up to 50 pounds; pushing and pulling; local driving; color perception; touch/feel; and the ability to move within and between facilities. Work includes frequent face-to-face and verbal interaction with others and may involve dirt or dust, fumes or odors, moving objects, and work at heights.

**Benefits**
============

401(k), dental insurance, health insurance, life insurance, paid time off, retirement plan, and vision insurance.

new_roles.title: Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
**Position Summary**

We are seeking a team-oriented, hands-on Plant Manager with a robust background in maintenance leadership. This role is responsible for overseeing all aspects of plant operations, with a particular emphasis on developing and executing a world-class maintenance program at our mill in St. Maries, Idaho. The ideal candidate will drive operational excellence, safety, and continuous improvement, ensuring the facility meets production goals while maintaining the highest standards of equipment reliability and team development.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the plant’s manufacturing and maintenance operations, ensuring safe, efficient, and reliable production.
* Oversee preventive, predictive, and proactive maintenance programs, including planning, scheduling, and execution.
* Direct and develop a multidisciplinary team, including Maintenance Planners, Millwrights, Electricians, Mechanics, and Production Supervisors.
* Foster a “Safety First” culture, ensuring compliance with all safety and environmental regulations and serving as a role model for safe industrial behavior.
* Collaborate with other departments (Finance, HR, Sales, Marketing, Resources) to align plant performance with company goals and market demands.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives, leveraging best practices in manufacturing and maintenance to optimize resources and processes.
* Lead and support improvement projects, including research, cost analysis, financial justification, and project management from conception to completion.
* Manage key performance indicators for maintenance and production, such as safety compliance, PM completion, downtime, overtime, expense controls, and plant cleanliness.
* Develop and retain high-performing teams through effective communication, training, and empowerment.
* Build strong relationships across the organization, ensuring active communication and teamwork.
* Utilize modern maintenance management tools (e.g., CMMS, AutoCAD, MS Suite) and interpret technical documents (e.g., blueprints).

**Qualifications**

* Proven experience in plant management or senior manufacturing leadership, with a strong track record in maintenance supervision and program development.
* Minimum of five years in maintenance leadership, with hands-on experience in preventive, predictive, and proactive maintenance.
* Strong technical skills in troubleshooting mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and strong understanding of PLC systems.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, motivate, and develop teams in a continuous improvement environment.
* Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Effective communicator, able to set clear expectations and drive accountability.
* Experience with process optimization.
* Business acumen to manage budgets, control costs, and justify investments.
* High school diploma required; college-level education in a related field preferred.

new_roles.title: Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
Work Model: This is a fully onsite role, with work performed at your designated Regal Rexnord office. 
 

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**SUMMARY**

Regal Rexnord is seeking a hands-on Plant Manager to serve as the operating leader for its filament-bearing production facility in Downers Grove, Illinois. The site manufactures filament-wound composite bearings for aerospace, defense, and heavy-industry applications. This position combines daily production management with overall facility leadership and accountability for safety, quality, delivery, cost, people, maintenance coordination, and continuous improvement.

The successful candidate will translate customer demand into clear daily priorities, lead disciplined execution within an AS9100-certified quality management system, develop frontline employees, and establish a visible, fact-based operating rhythm. This role requires strong floor presence, sound judgment, and the ability to solve problems at their source without compromising safety or compliance.

 
 

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Lead daily and weekly production execution, including staffing, work-center priorities, material readiness, equipment availability, schedule attainment, and recovery planning.
* Provide senior on-site leadership for routine facility operations and maintain clear ownership for safety, housekeeping, 5S, emergency readiness, contractor activity, and general facility condition.
* Lead a proactive safety culture through employee engagement, hazard identification, floor observations, incident and near-miss follow-up, and timely corrective-action closure.
* Ensure production complies with the AS9100 quality management system, approved work instructions, specifications, inspection plans, traceability requirements, record controls, and change-management processes.
* Partner with Quality to contain nonconforming product, protect customers, complete root-cause analysis, implement corrective action, and verify sustained effectiveness.
* Lead, coach, and hold accountable approximately 25 direct labor and maintenance employees; establish expectations for safety, quality, attendance, teamwork, productivity, and conduct.
* Build staffing, skills, cross-training, and succession plans; ensure employees are trained and qualified before performing assigned work.
* Prioritize maintenance activity based on safety, quality, production risk, and customer need; improve preventive-maintenance discipline and eliminate recurring equipment failures.
* Use daily visual management and tiered escalation to review safety, quality, delivery, cost, people, and equipment performance.
* Lead continuous-improvement activity that increases throughput, reduces lead time and inventory, improves labor productivity, and lowers the cost of poor quality.
* Manage controllable spending, overtime, supplies, maintenance expense, and operating variances within delegated authority.
* Provide the General Manager with clear operating updates covering performance, risks, recovery actions, resource needs, and decisions required.
 

 

**Critical Competencies**

* Demonstrated ability to manage safety, quality, production, delivery, labor, maintenance priorities, and operating metrics in a regulated or high-reliability environment.
* Working knowledge of AS9100 or a comparable structured quality management system, including nonconformance control, corrective action, document control, traceability, and audit support.
* Experience with ERP or production-planning systems and the ability to interpret schedules, routers, work instructions, drawings, specifications, inspection information, and operating data.
* Strong communication, structured problem-solving, conflict-resolution, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to work regularly on the production floor and respond to operating issues outside normal administrative hours when required.
 

 

**Education and Experience Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, manufacturing, operations, business, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant manufacturing leadership experience.
* Five or more years of progressive manufacturing experience, including at least three years leading production employees or manufacturing teams.
