Expected salary: $110,000 – $129,000 annually + a 10% bonus

The salary range provided is intended to display the value of the company's base pay compensation for this position. Salary is dependent on a multitude of factors, including but not limited to the physical worksite location, the geographic market of that location, candidate's skill set, level of experience, education and internal peer compensation comparisons among other potential factors.

 

**Physical Demand and Work Environment**
========================================

Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* + **Physical Demands -** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand. The employee frequently is required to walk; use hands to manipulate, handle, or feel; reach with arms; and talk or hear. The employee must be able to lift and manipulate up to 50 pounds and occasionally required to lift and/or move up to 70 pounds. Must be able to occasionally stand for a portion of shift. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, and the ability to adjust focus. Per AS9100 requirements, an up-to-date vision test should be made available to management and may be shared with auditors.
 + **Work Environment** - The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. The noise levels in the work environment are usually moderate. However, in some instances this job does require work in areas where ear protection is necessary. The use of safety glasses and safety toe shoes are required.

**Benefits**
============

* Medical, Dental, Vision and Prescription Drug Coverage
* Spending accounts (HSA, Health Care FSA and Dependent Care FSA)
* Paid Time Off and Holidays
* 401k Retirement Plan with Matching Employer Contributions
* Life and Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D) Insurance
* Paid Leaves
* Tuition Assistance

**About Regal Rexnord**
=======================

Regal Rexnord is a publicly held global industrial manufacturer with 30,000 associates around the world who help create a better tomorrow by providing sustainable solutions that power, transmit and control motion. The Company’s electric motors and air moving subsystems provide the power to create motion. A portfolio of highly engineered power transmission components and subsystems efficiently transmits motion to power industrial applications. The Company’s automation offering, comprised of controls, actuators, drives, and precision motors, controls motion in applications ranging from factory automation to precision control in surgical tools.

 

The Company’s end markets benefit from meaningful secular demand tailwinds, and include factory automation, food & beverage, aerospace, medical, data center, warehouse, alternative energy, residential and commercial buildings, general industrial, construction, metals and mining, and agriculture.

Regal Rexnord is comprised of three operating segments: Industrial Powertrain Solutions, Power Efficiency Solutions, and Automation & Motion Control. Regal Rexnord has offices and manufacturing, sales and service facilities worldwide. For more information, including a copy of our Sustainability Report, visit RegalRexnord.com.

**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement**
==========================================

Regal Rexnord is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex/gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, age, ancestry, national origin, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status (unless required by the applicable law or government contract), disability or protected veteran status or any other status or characteristic protected by law. Regal Rexnord is committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce. We are committed to building a team that represents diverse and inclusive backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. If you’d like to view a copy of the company’s affirmative action plan for protected veterans/individuals with disabilities or policy statement, please email Recruiting@RegalRexnord.com. If you have a disability and you believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or to submit an online application, please e-mail Recruiting@RegalRexnord.com.

In the absence of a signed Master Service Agreement or similar contract and approval from HR to submit resumes for a specific requisition, Regal Rexnord will not consider or approve payment to any third-parties for hires made.

**Job Details:**

**Summary**

This position is responsible for all functional areas of a poultry processing plant, including the efficient operation of three production shifts, maintenance, personnel safety, shipping and receiving, sanitation, scheduling, quality, and process improvement. The role also includes motivating managers to provide guidance and development programs that enhance employee skill levels, resolving issues related to the quality of incoming and outgoing goods, and reviewing cost and performance data to identify areas for improvement.

Additional responsibilities include compiling monthly expense and efficiency reports, promoting and explaining Total Quality Management (TQM) philosophy to employees, and obtaining approval for and executing all plant capital improvement projects. This position is responsible for facilitating Talent Mapping and Succession Planning programs and supporting retention initiatives. The role is also accountable for food safety, food quality, and product legality.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Direct and oversee all functional areas of a poultry processing plant.
* Ensure the efficient operation of three production shifts, including maintenance, personnel safety, shipping and receiving, sanitation, scheduling, quality, and process improvement activities.
* Motivate and support managers in providing guidance and development programs to enhance employee skills and performance.
* Resolve issues related to the quality of incoming and outgoing goods.
* Analyze cost and performance data to identify opportunities for operational improvement.
* Compile and present monthly expense and efficiency reports.
* Promote and communicate the principles of Total Quality Management (TQM) throughout the facility.
* Obtain approval for and execute all plant capital improvement projects.
* Facilitate Talent Mapping and Succession Planning programs.
* Support employee retention initiatives.
* Maintain accountability for food safety, food quality, and product legality.
* Initiate and implement improvements across all phases of production.
* Assist in identifying, evaluating, and correcting operational problems.
* Perform other duties and responsibilities as needed.

**Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, typically acquired through four years of college-level study in a general professional or technical field.

**Experience**

* Eight (8) or more years of progressive leadership experience required.
* Experience in the poultry industry or the food processing industry preferred.

**Computer Skills**

* General knowledge of computer applications used in plant operations, including Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft PowerPoint and Microsoft Outlook
* Working knowledge of SAP systems preferred.

**Communication Skills**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

* Ability to travel approximately 6 to 11 times per year.

new_roles.description:
**Win at Wilsonart**
====================

At Wilsonart, we don’t just make surfaces—we build careers. When you join our team, you become part of something bigger: a company driven by innovation, grounded in values, and powered by people who care.

You’ll be surrounded by teammates who take pride in their work and look out for one another. You’ll have the chance to learn, grow and make a real impact. And you’ll be part of a company that believes winning means helping you succeed at work and in life.

Here, you’ll win with:

Support that keeps you well

* Medical, dental, and life insurance
* Company-paid short- and long-term disability
* FSAs and dependent care options
* Vision and legal benefits
* Gym discounts and wellness clinics
* Tuition reimbursement—for you and your dependents

Opportunities to grow

* Clear paths to promotion and internal mobility
* Training, coaching, and mentorship
* Development programs to support your goals

Time for what matters

* Paid vacation and holidays in your first year
* A culture that respects work-life balance

**Job Description:**

**JOB SUMMARY**

Owns overall site performance and full P&L responsibility for the plant. Accountable for delivering Safety, Quality, Customer Service, and Cost commitments while building the organization, systems, and continuous improvement capability required to scale the operation from commissioning through full-rate production.

**DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

**P&L & Cost Management**

* Owns the plant P&L: develops, proposes, and manages the annual operating and capital budgets; drives cost, margin, and productivity performance against plan and explains variances with corrective action plans.
* Reviews, proposes, and approves as appropriate plans controlling budget spending, labor efficiency, material efficiency, engineering effectiveness, and customer service.
* Reviews cost control reports, cost estimates, headcount utilization, and conversion cost per unit for the operation.
* Reviews and proposes projects involving functional or organizational changes within the operation; builds the business case and tracks realized benefit.

**Operations & Production Standards**

* Maintains production operations standards consistent with company and site Safety, Quality, Productivity, and Cost requirements in order to exceed customer expectations (annual plant objectives and monthly scorecard).
* Reviews performance against operating plans and standards; requires interpretation of results from direct reports and approves changes in direction of plans.
* Resolves priority conflicts across lines and ensures lines are balanced and performing according to planning system rules.

**Continuous Improvement & Growth**

* Drives volume growth and productivity improvement by implementing Lean and continuous improvement methodologies across coating, curing, digital print, and material handling operations.
* Develops short- and long-term plans and programs for plant growth, including capacity, staffing, and capital investment roadmaps.
* Facilitates new product and new substrate/chemistry launches to assure successful implementation and rapid qualification.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Coordinates with support functions (Supply Chain and Planning, Continuous Improvement, Quality, Safety, Engineering, Finance, and Human Resources) to establish and implement systems supporting production operations goals.
* Partners with commercial teams on customer commitments, service levels, and cost-to-serve.

**People Leadership**

* Selects, develops, and retains qualified personnel in all positions reporting directly or indirectly; provides training, guidance, performance appraisals, and career development.

**Safety, Quality & Compliance**

* Responsible for compliance with all regulatory, corporate, and local policies (safety, environmental, quality, employment).
* Ensures a safe working environment and personally models and promotes safe work practices throughout the operation.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in an Engineering or Business discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 5+ years of experience in successful manufacturing operations, with demonstrated ownership of cost or P&L performance.
* 2+ years of experience in a direct people leadership position, with a track record of growing and developing direct reports.
* Familiarity with ERP systems (Oracle or equivalent) in a plant or departmental leadership capacity is a plus.

**Certifications & Licenses**

* Lean/Six Sigma certification preferred

**Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities**

* Demonstrated track record applying Lean manufacturing techniques and leading in a team-based work environment.
* Business Operating System experience: Familiarity with Business Operating/Quality Systems or a comparable Lean Continuous Improvement framework, along with the analytical tools that support it, 80/20 root cause analysis, problem solving tool deployment, statistical process control (SPC), 5S, etc., with a demonstrated ability to use data to drive measurable improvements in safety, quality, OTIF and productivity.
* Business acumen and cost consciousness: understands the business implications of decisions, works within approved budgets, proactively develops cost-saving measures, and contributes to profit and revenue.
* Excellent verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills; presents numerical data effectively to plant, functional, and executive audiences.Owns overall site performance and full P&L responsibility for the plant. Accountable for delivering Safety, Quality, Customer Service, and Cost commitments while building the organization, systems, and continuous improvement capability required to scale the operation from commissioning through full-rate production.

*We’re looking for people who are ready to learn, ready to lead and ready to make a difference. If that sounds like you, you can win at Wilsonart.*

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, sex, age, physical or mental disability, veteran or military status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, military status, order of protection status, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state, or local law.*

As a Plant Manager here at Honeywell, you will be responsible for overseeing the operations and performance of our manufacturing plant. You will develop and implement strategies to optimize plant operations, improve productivity, and reduce costs. Ensuring compliance with safety regulations and promoting a culture of safety throughout the plant will be a key responsibility.

You will report directly to our VP ISC Americas & Pacific and you’ll work out of our Tempe, Arizona location on an On-site work schedule.

In this role, you will impact the success of our business by leading and managing a team to meet production targets and deliver on customer commitments. You will play a critical role in ensuring the efficient production of high-quality products while maintaining a safe and productive work environment. Your leadership and strategic decision-making skills will be essential in driving operational excellence and achieving business objectives.

 

**YOU MUST HAVE**

* Minimum of 6 years of experience in plant management or a similar leadership role.
* Strong knowledge of manufacturing processes and best practices.
* Proven track record of driving operational excellence and achieving business objectives.
* Minimum of 6 years of experience in managing plant budgets and resources effectively to meet financial goals.
* Ability to lead continuous improvement initiatives and implement best practices in a manufacturing environment.
* Minimum of 6 years of experience in Electronic assembly process experience.

**WE VALUE**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field.
* Experience with Lean Six Sigma certification and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Strong financial acumen and ability to manage budgets effectively.
* Experience in developing and leading diverse teams to achieve operational goals.
Excellent problem-solving skills and strategic decision-making abilities.

new_roles.description:
**Plant Manager I**

850 W Gowen Rd, Boise, ID 83705, USA

Full-time

**Job Description**

Norco is currently seeking an individual to fill our Plant Manager I position. The Plant Manager I is accountable for the overall safe, compliant, reliable, efficient, and financially responsible operation of the production facility. The position establishes facility strategy and operating priorities, develops the leadership team, allocates resources, manages operational and regulatory risk, drives performance, and leads long-term improvement to support production capacity, customer service, and business continuity. Other responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

**Plant Leadership and Strategy**

* Provide overall leadership and direction for the production facility and assigned support functions.
* Establish facility goals, staffing plans, operating priorities, budgets, capital priorities, reliability priorities, and improvement strategies.
* Maintain overall facility accountability for employee safety, product quality, regulatory compliance, customer service, production capacity, equipment reliability, operating cost, inventory control, and business continuity.
 

**Leadership Development and Organizational Capability**

* Build, direct, and develop the plant leadership team; establish clear accountability for supervisors and managers; assess leadership effectiveness; and maintain succession and development plans for critical facility roles.
* Approve or recommend hiring, promotion, compensation, discipline, and termination decisions within assigned authority.

**Operational and Financial Performance**

* Review plant performance through KPI's, safety, quality, production, service, labor, training, inventory, maintenance, downtime, and financial measures.
* Require recovery plans and corrective action when plant or department performance does not meet expectations.
* Plan and request approval for operating expenditures, capital projects, staffing changes, and other resources needed to meet business requirements.
* Balance production capacity, service requirements, operating cost, equipment reliability, inventory, and plant resources when making operating decisions.
* Approve major operating commitments and significant resource decisions within assigned authority.

**Safety, Quality, and Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure operations are conducted in accordance with applicable company safety rules, procedures, work instructions, quality requirements, and assigned personal protective equipment requirements.
* Ensure required production and regulated records receive review and approval by properly trained and authorized personnel.
* Lead or oversee significant incidents, root-cause analyses, corrective actions, audit responses, product-quality events, regulatory interactions, service disruptions, and business-continuity responses. 
 Cross-Functional Leadership
* Coordinate significant facility matters with Gas Operations, Quality, Safety, Human Resources, Sales, Customer Service, Distribution, Maintenance, Procurement, Finance, Information Technology, and branch leadership.
* Communicate plant risks, performance, operating constraints, resource needs, and significant decisions clearly and promptly to appropriate stakeholders.
* Participate in company planning, leadership meetings, management reviews, emergency response, and special projects.
* Maintain sufficient technical knowledge to evaluate operating risk and make informed management decisions.
* Stay informed of and adhere to company policies and procedures.

**Supervision**

* Incumbent works under general supervision and exercises substantial independent judgment within established company policies, approved budgets, regulatory requirements, and assigned authority.

**Organizational Role**

* Manager - plans and assigns work to accomplish facility and departmental goals; responsible for leadership, hiring, employee development, performance management, resource allocation, and operating outcomes for assigned employees and functions.

**Qualifications**

**Required Education and Experience:**

* Five years of progressively responsible experience in production, manufacturing, compressed gas, chemical processing, distribution, or a related operational environment.
* Three years of successful experience leading supervisors, departments, or comparable operational workgroups.
* Equivalent combinations of education, training, and relevant experience may be considered.
* Valid driver's license.
* Forklift certification or ability to become certified if required.
* Comprehensive understanding of production leadership, safety management, quality systems, regulatory compliance, operating risk, budgeting, capital planning, and resource allocation.
* Working knowledge of industrial, medical, specialty, and fuel gases; cylinders; production equipment; cylinder maintenance; material handling; loading; and related plant operations.
* Ability to lead managers and supervisors, establish accountability, develop employees, and support succession planning.
* Strong judgment regarding safety, regulatory, legal, operational, customer-service, reputational, and financial risk.
* Excellent organizational, decision-making, root-cause analysis, change-management, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to analyze operational and financial measures and translate findings into effective priorities and corrective actions.
* Ability to communicate concisely with employees, branch personnel, company leadership, customers, contractors, auditors, and regulators.
* Ability to safely handle compressed gas cylinders and use material-handling aids as required.

**Preferred Education and Experience**:

* Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, physical science, operations management, or a related field.
* Experience in compressed gas production, medical gas production, specialty gas operations, fuel gas operations, cylinder maintenance, or regulated manufacturing.
* Experience with quality assurance, audits, regulated documentation, budgets, capital projects, reliability, and continuous improvement.

**Additional information**

Norco offers a competitive compensation/benefit package, including:

* Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)
* Health, Vision and Dental Insurance
* Health Savings Account (HSA)
* Medical and Dependent Care Flex Accounts (FSA)
* Life Insurance provided at no cost to employee by Norco
* Supplemental Accident, Disease, and Life Insurance options
* Employee Tuition Reimbursement
* 401(k) with Employer Matching
* Employee Discount on products sold by Norco

**Company Description**

Founded in 1948, Norco is headquartered in Boise, Idaho and has more than 70 branches in Idaho, Montana, Oregon, Nevada, Washington, Utah and Wyoming. As a family and employee owned company we operate the nation's largest independent gas manufacturer/distributor of welding, safety, medical equipment and supplies. Norco is proud to be among the thousands of privately-owned businesses nationwide that offer their employees a meaningful stake in the business through employee stock ownership (ESOP).

At Norco we share a common mission: "Serving You Better." Treating customers, suppliers and each other with respect and dignity is our top priority. We work hard every day to serve others and create rich lives for our employees, their families, and the communities where we work and live.

**Norco, Inc is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer**

Norco provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

**Norco, Inc is a Drug-Free workplace.**

**Pacific Coast Producers |** Full-Time | On-Site | Exempt 
**Salary Range:** $160,000- $200,000 /year (based on experience)

**Pacific Coast Producers** (PCP), a growing agricultural cooperative with food production facilities across the West Coast, is seeking an experienced and strategic **Plant Manager** to lead our Production Facility **in Lodi, CA**. PCP is dedicated to investing in its people and fostering a culture of service, where each employee can do their best to make affordable, high-quality food for customers across North America.

Join our legacy of talented people working together to innovate and lead our industry. As a member of PCP, you will have access to a comprehensive benefits package that includes top-quality, medical, dental, and vision insurance, generous paid time off, and a retirement savings plan to help secure your future.

The Plant Manager will have overall accountability for directing and managing plant operations to meet quality, food safety, and customer requirements in a safe, cost-effective, and timely manner. The plant employs over 800 employees during the processing season and maintains an experienced year-round staff. The Plant Manager reports directly to the Director of Operations.

**What You'll Do:**

* Lead all aspects of plant operations, ensuring safe, efficient, and high-quality production
* Develop and execute production plans aligned with raw material supply, demand, labor, and plant capacity
* Drive performance against key metrics including safety, quality, throughput, and cost
* Own operating and capital budgets; analyzing performance and implementing corrective actions
* Champion food safety, environmental compliance, and regulatory adherence (OSHA, FDA, SQF, HACCP, HARPC, GMPs)
* Build, coach, and develop strong teams through clear expectations and consistent leadership
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency, reliability, and profitability
* Partner effectively with union leadership to maintain a positive and productive work environment
* Oversee capital projects and internal investments to support future growth and operational excellence

**What You Bring to the Team:**

* 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in food manufacturing including aseptic processing, canning, or similar method.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, or related field
* Proven ability to lead large teams in a fast-paced, unionized setting
* Proven experience with process flows, automated controls, review of AutoCAD drawings, and dealing with industrial processing equipment vendors and mechanical contractors.
* Strong operational and financial acumen, including budgeting and performance analysis
* Demonstrated success driving continuous improvement and leading change
* Deep understanding of food safety systems and regulatory requirements (GFSI, HACCP, HARPC, FDA, OSHA)
* Hands-on leadership style with strong problem-solving capability
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results under tight timelines
* Strong communication skills with the ability to influence across all levels of the organization

**Why Join PCP?**

At PCP, we take care of our people. Here are just a few of the benefits full-time employees enjoy:

* **Competitive pay** with opportunities for advancement.
* **This position is eligible for our annual profit-sharing bonus program**.
* **Medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family, starting the first of the month after you join us.**
* **Retirement plans** to support your long-term security.
* **Paid time off** including vacation, holidays, parental leave, sick leave, and bereavement.
* **Life and disability insurance** plus an Employee Assistance Program.
* **Development opportunities** through online courses, classroom training, and on-the-job growth.
* The stability of a **farmer-owned cooperative** with more than 50 years of success.
* A mission-driven culture focused on **feeding families across North America.**

**Salary Range: $160,000 - $200,000/year (based on experience).** This is a **full-time, on-site** role based at our production facility Lodi, CA.

The base salary range reflects the reasonable expectation for what the company anticipates paying for this role at the time of posting. The actual salary offered will depend on factors including, but not limited to:

* Relevant skills, education, and experience
* Job-related qualifications and certifications
* Internal pay equity
* Market conditions and business needs

**Sponsorship:** This role is not eligible for current or future visa sponsorship.

**About PCP Summary**

Founded in 1971, Pacific Coast Producers is owned by more than 165 family farmers who cultivate and deliver a diverse range of crops including tomatoes, peaches, pears, grapes, cherries, and more. Our cooperative operates multiple processing and packaging facilities across the West Coast, supplying top-quality products to grocery retailers and foodservice distributors throughout the U.S. and Canada.

Our Lodi Production facility is a bustling hub where delicious apples, peaches, and apricots are transformed into high-quality products. The facility is equipped with advanced machinery and cutting-edge technology, enabling efficient and precise sorting, peeling, and slicing of the fruits. Meticulous attention is paid to every step of the process, ensuring that only the finest fruits make their way into the final products.

Nestled in the heart of San Joaquin County and just a short 45-minute drive from Sacramento, our Production Facility is located in the charming city of Lodi, CA. Lodi is renowned for its rich history in winemaking and agriculture, as well as its vibrant downtown area and close-knit community. With a great quality of life, Lodi offers a welcoming environment to those seeking a relaxed and enjoyable lifestyle.

**AA/EEO Policy Statement**

Pacific Coast Producers is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. No employee or applicant will be discriminated against in any condition of employment because of race, color, national origin, sex, religion, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

new_roles.title: Plant Manager Job
new_roles.description:
Arkema's Birdsboro, PA site is seeking a Plant Manager (PM) with a proven track record of change management, people leadership and continuous improvement. The PM has direct responsibility for the overall operation of the Birdsboro plant. This position is responsible for the Birdsboro sites Replacement Asset Value (RAV) of approximately $120 million (original purchase cost of approximately $65 million), Replacement Plant Earnings (RPE) of approximately $12 million, annual variable costs exceeding $75 million (including monomers), and annual CAPEX of $4-5 million.

This position has 6 direct reports, each in a site leadership role and indirect responsibility for all other hourly and salaried employees. Birdsboro is a union site.

The PM has full P/L responsibility and provides leadership, direction, and management for all aspects of the plant’s manufacturing operations. The PM assists in the creation of the organization’s vision and growth strategies and executes the business and operations plans to achieve revenue, profit, and performance targets while continuing the plant’s record of success and high levels of safety and customer service.. 
 
The Plant Manager directly supports Plant Staff to manage activities and lead continued improvement in the areas of Operations, Maintenance, Human Resources, Engineering, Accounting, Purchasing, Quality, and Laboratories. The PM possesses a strong, working knowledge of and ensures compliance with; external regulatory requirements, industry best practices, and internal policies and procedures (specifically capital, accounting, purchasing, and HES).
 
 
**Essential Duties & Responsibilities with % Breakdown:** 
Safety and Environment – 20% 
HSE responsibilities include but are not restricted to those outlined in Leadership expectations such as reporting any incident in a timely manner. 

* Ensures plant is in full compliance with Arkema guidance and directives along with all applicable regulations.
* Foster a culture of Safety as a core plant value.
* Directly participates in core Arkema programs such as BBS.

Operations – 50% 
Ensures that safe operating procedures and practices are in place and followed. Ensures that mechanical integrity of all plants is maintained or improved to allow safe and efficient operation. Ensures that the plant produces at volumes to meet demand requirements set forth in S&OP plans. Ensures that adequate training is provided for a safe and efficient plant operations. 
Human Resources – 10% 
Works with site HR to see that employee activities related to hiring, promotion, layoff, salary, etc. are handled professionally. Provides an atmosphere for open communication between all employees. 
Financial–10% 
Directly accountable to prepare various budgets (fixed, variable and capex) then monitors and controls to ensure these budgets are met. 
Others: 10% 
o Communication: direct contact with both internal and external stakeholders 

* Mentoring/Coaching: Develop close working relationships with plant personnel and places a strong focus on improving both individual and team performance supporting programs such as SMART

**Minimum Qualifications and Education Required** 
Min Years of Experience 

* Minimum of 15 years of progressive manufacturing experience in plant operations, process design, and engineering, preferably in both a large and small-size integrated process manufacturing company

Education and area of focus 

* Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering required.

 
Certifications/Trainings: 
Lean or Six Sigma certification preferred

**About Us:**

TreeHouse Foods is a leading manufacturer of private label packaged foods and beverages, operating a network of over 20 production facilities and several corporate offices across the United States and Canada. At TreeHouse Foods, our commitment to excellence extends beyond our products and revolves around our people. We are investing in talent and creating a performance-based culture where employees can do their best work and develop their careers, directly impacting our mission to make high quality, affordable food for our customers, communities, and families. We hope you will consider joining the team and being part of our future.

Named one of America’s Best Large Employers by Forbes Magazine, we are proud to live by a strong set of values and strive to "Engage and Delight – One Customer at a Time." Guided by our values— **Own It, Commit to Excellence, Be Agile, Speak Up, and Better Together.** We are a diverse team driven by integrity, accountability, and a commitment to exceptional results. We embrace change, prioritize continuous learning, and foster collaboration, transparency, and healthy debate. Together, we set each other up for success to achieve enterprise-wide goals.

**What You Gain:**

* Competitive compensation and benefits program with no waiting period – you’re eligible from your first day!
* 401(k) program with 5% employer match and 100% vesting as soon as you enroll.
* Comprehensive paid time off opportunities, including immediate access to four weeks of vacation, five sick days, parental leave and 11 company holidays (including two floating holidays).
* Leaders who are invested in supporting your accelerated career growth, plus paid training, tuition reimbursement and a robust educational platform – DevelopU – with more than 10,000 free courses to support you along the way.
* An inclusive working environment where you can build meaningful work relationships with a diverse group of professionals. Take advantage of opportunities to build on our team-oriented culture, such as joining one of our Employee Resource Groups.
* Access to our wellness and employee assistance programs.

**Job Description:**

***About the Role:***

 

We are seeking a Plant Manager for our Cambridge, MD, facility, a leading manufacturer of quality aseptic products. This role is responsible for providing overall leadership and accountability for plant operations with a strong focus on delivering results. In partnership with the site leadership team, the Plant Manager will drive employee engagement, safety, quality, customer service, continuous improvement, cost management, and production performance to meet or exceed business objectives. The successful candidate will identify and implement strategic opportunities to improve operational efficiency, safety, throughput, productivity, schedule attainment, cost reduction, and product quality while fostering a positive and high-performing work environment.

 

***You will add value to this role by performing various functions including, but not limited to:***

* Providing coaching and leadership to team members in the areas of employee engagement, safety, quality, customer service, continuous improvement, cost, and equipment reliability to elevate the team’s performance.
* Promoting a safety culture and ensuring adherence to all health and safety policies/protocols.
* Leading the development, execution, and monitoring of the operations strategy in line with the overall operational objectives to achieve safety, quality and performance improvement and ensure achievement of manufacturing goals.
* Leading the continuous improvement program to deliver opportunities in cost, quality, food safety and service.
* Utilizing available data including OEE, line speed target, and efficiency and process data to continuously improve productivity, uptime, and reliability.
* Coordinating manufacturing activities with all other functions of the organization and suppliers to obtain optimum production and utilization of human resources, machines, and equipment.
Contribute to the development and execution of strategic plant-wide initiatives. 

 

***Important Details:***

* This is a full-time, on-site role on first shift. Occasional flexibility is required to support alternate shifts.
The anticipated compensation for this position ranges from $154,700.00 - 232,100.00 USD annually. This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics and business or organizational needs. For certain roles, the successful candidate may be eligible for annual discretionary merit compensation award, bonus and equity pay. 

 

***You’ll fit right in if you have:***

* High school diploma or equivalent is required; Bachelor's degree in manufacturing, industrial technology, or related field is preferred.
* Minimum of five years of leadership experience in a production or food manufacturing environment.
* Strong leadership and team management skills.
* Experience leading in a union environment is preferred.
* Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing Principles.
* Knowledge of safety regulations, quality control procedures, and inventory management.
* Excellent problem-solving, troubleshooting, and decision-making skills.
Proficient in Microsoft Office. 

**Your TreeHouse Foods Career is Just a Click Away!**

Click on the “Apply” button or go directly to www.treehousefoods.com/careers to let us know you’re ready to join our team!

*At TreeHouse Foods, we embrace diversity and inclusion for innovation and growth. We are committed to building inclusive teams and an equitable workplace for our employees to bring their true selves to work to help us “Engage and Delight – One Customer at a Time”.* *TreeHouse Foods is an Equal Opportunity Employer that prohibits discrimination or harassment of any type. new_roles.description:
**Job Posting End Date**

11-15-2026

Please note the job posting will close on the day before the posting end date.

**Job Summary**

The Plant Manager will direct the activities of the plant employees in a safe, compliant, reliable, and economical manner including electric power production, maintenance, engineering, construction, accounting, procurement, materials management, human resources, public affairs, tax matters and compliance with regulating agencies. Responsible for establishing and maintaining two-way communications with employees, managers and the general public. Provide leadership and manage change by the development of a culture that promotes/supports teamwork, process improvement activities, employee development, and proper recognition and reward.

**Job Description**

**What You'll Do:**

 

* Plan, organize, coordinate, direct and control plant activities including the operation, maintenance, engineering and construction of the plant's facilities in a safe, efficient and economical manner.
* Support the System Safety Process. Develop, maintain and enforce safe working conditions by providing proper and adequate tools, equipment, protective clothing and devices, and training. Establish and enforce safe work behaviors. Participate in the setting of safety goals for an accident-free work environment. Communicate to employees about the importance of a safe work environment on a daily basis. Investigate, report and track incidents/accidents including root cause analysis and corrective action taken. Report findings to management and to employees.
* Develop long range plans for maintenance and operational excellence, capital improvements, equipment availability, cultural transformation, and the plant organization's succession planning requirements.
* Direct long range planning activities including maintenance management, materials management, QA/QC, human resources, accounting, predictive and preventative maintenance systems, and public relations.
* Develop short range (three years to coincide with the investment review committee) plan and forecasts in cooperation with engineering and maintenance personnel; develop budgets, prepare variance reports and control expenditures to meet approved budgets.
* Direct the operation of plant activities to ensure compliance with all local, state and federal laws and regulations and compliance with company policies and procedures.
* Participate in the formulation of company policies and procedures pertaining to plant operations.
* Establish and maintain close liaison with city, county, local and other officials and industrial leaders, and inform appropriate persons of actions, proposals and plans that have a bearing on plant operations and activities.

**What We're Looking For:**

Education: Bachelor’s degree in mechanical or electrical engineering, business management; or associate degree in a technical field, chemistry, environmental services, accounting, or equivalent applied knowledge (see experience).

Experience: Minimum of 8 years' experience including work in plant operations, maintenance, and performance areas. Experience should include business/financial and human resources administration. A minimum of eight years supervising others. OTHER REQUIREMENTS: Physical demand level is Sedentary.

Training should include company courses in leadership, supervision, change-management, team skills, problem solving & decision making, process improvement, safety, business skills and other relevant courses.

**What You’ll Get:**

In addition to a competitive compensation, AEP offers a unique comprehensive benefits package that aims to support and enhance the overall well-being of our employees.

**Where Putting the Customer First Powers Everything We Do!**

At AEP, we’re more than just an energy company — we’re a team of dedicated professionals committed to delivering safe, reliable, and innovative energy solutions. Guided by our mission to put the customer first, we strive to exceed expectations by listening, responding, and continuously improving the way we serve our communities. If you're passionate about making a meaningful impact and being part of a forward-thinking organization, this is the company for you!

Amrize is building North America. From bridges and railways to data centers, schools, offices and homes, our solutions are inside the buildings and infrastructure that connect people and advance how we live. And we invite you to come and build with us.

As the partner of choice for professional builders, we offer advanced branded solutions from foundation to rooftop. Wherever our customers are, whatever their job, we’re ready to deliver. Infrastructure, commercial and residential, new build, repair and refurbishment: We’re in every construction market.

Amrize listed on the New York Stock Exchange and the SIX Swiss Exchange on June 23, 2025, following our spinoff as an independent company. Join us and build *your* ambition.

Description:

Join Amrize as a Plant Manager - Aggregate and help construct what's next. If you're ready to put your skills to work on projects that matter — and build a career with a company that’s building North America — we want to hear from you!

 

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

The basic function of the Plant Manager is to provide the necessary leadership to plan, direct, organize, coordinate and control the mining of raw materials and the production of shippable product at the assigned Plant in a manner to meet Aggregate Dispatcher requests on a timely and cost efficient basis. The Plant Manager will be tasked with ensuring that an appropriate quality product is made at the Plant.

The Plant Manager will ensure proper staffing and monitoring of the inventory status at the Plant and in addition will coordinate activities with the following departments: Aggregate Operations Department - Dispatch, Maintenance, and Quality Control of the Region in addition Regional Administration/Financial function.

The Plant Manager will analyze and monitor production efficiency / productivity to ensure the Company is fully utilizing on site vehicles and plant equipment at the assigned location. In addition, the Plant Manager will develop mining and production strategies and tactics to ensure an approach to raise productivity levels, maintaining safety as a top propriety, while controlling the costs of the assigned location.

 

**WHAT YOU'LL ACCOMPLISH**

* Consistently identify new operational opportunities and develop strategies for accomplishing the attainment of improved efficiency and productivity.
* Address the needs of the customer while at the same time promoting and protecting the long-term interests of the Company.
* Initiate and implement production and scheduling related programs, strategies and techniques that result in increased productivity, and maintain safe operations of the assigned Plant, while containing the budgeted expenses of the assigned plants.
* Manage the performances of subordinate personnel, work independently, meet deadlines and manage the assigned Plant with fiscal integrity.
* Delegate responsibilities; must be able to objectively evaluate the performance of subordinates; and must be able to hold others accountable in a constructive manner.
* Participate in Company safety inspections.
* Communicate with site crew which includes plant operator, loader operators and laborers
* Supervise team to maintain production and efficiency. Schedule production and execute preventative maintenance routines
* Maintain sufficient inventory levels at site to service customers’ needs
* Coordinate safety issues and investigate incidents with safety department. Ensure environmental compliance, rehabilitation and meeting permit obligations
* Demonstrate a commitment to communicating, improving and adhering to health, safety and environmental policies in all work environments and areas. Promote a culture of safety and exhibit these behaviors.
 

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

**Education:** Bachelor's degree

**Field of Study Preferred:** Mining Engineering, Management
 
**Required Work Experience**: 5-7 years Aggregate Mining and related Raw Materials Plant Production experience

**Required Technical Skills:** Computer proficiency required. SAP experience would be a plus

 

**Additional Requirements:**

* Successful candidates must adhere to all safety protocols and proper use of Amrize approved Personal Protection Equipment ("PPE"), including but not limited to respirators. Subject to applicable law, employees that are required to wear respirators must be clean shaven where the respirator seal meets the face in order to pass the qualitative and quantitative fit tests.
 

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* Competitive salary
* Savings: Choose from 401(k) pre-tax and/or Roth after-tax savings
* Medical, Dental, Disability and Life Insurance
* Holistic Health & Well-being programs
* Health Savings Accounts (HSAs) & Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs) for health and dependent care
* Vision and other Voluntary benefits and discounts
* Paid time off & paid holidays
* Paid Parental Leave (maternity & paternity)

new_roles.title: Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
R10104082 Plant Manager (Open)

Location:

Carnegie, PA

**How will you CONTRIBUTE and GROW?**
-------------------------------------

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace that embraces the unique perspectives of our employees, our customers, patients, community stakeholders, and cultures across the world. We believe that a variety of backgrounds makes our team stronger and more innovative.

**At Airgas, we RESPECT, HONOR and VALUE diversity.**
=====================================================

 

**Airgas is Hiring for a Plant Manager in Carnegie, PA**
========================================================

 

***We are looking for you !***

 

* **Comprehensive Family Benefits:** Airgas offers a full benefits package designed to support your whole life, including Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, AD&D, and Disability Insurance.
* **Support for Parents:** We offer a 14-week paid child birth benefit to support growing families.
* **Future Security:** 401(k) Retirement Plan with company match, Tuition Assistance, Paid Holidays, Vacation, and Sick time.
* **Early Access:** Your benefits start after just 30 days of employment.

 

The Plant Manager is responsible for leading and empowering the team engaged in producing and repackaging of compressed and liquid gases into cylinders, correcting unsafe acts or conditions without delay, and aligning daily responsibilities with team members according to customer needs, current stock levels and team strengths.

* Ensures the safe operation and maintenance of the plant for pumping or repackaging of gases into cylinders while ensuring compliance with all federal, state, local and company policies, procedures, regulations and laws. Maintains a neat, clean and orderly plant appearance.
* Studies production schedules and estimates team-hour requirements for completion of job assignments. Establishes and/or adjusts work procedures collaboratively to meet production schedules.
* Partners with the team to enhance production methods, equipment performance, and product quality. Adapts workflows and use of equipment to support team productivity and well-being.
* Ensures all safety rules are strictly observed and safety training is regularly scheduled, conducted and documented. Interpret company policies to team members and foster a culture of safety adherence.
* Ensures all injuries and accidents are properly investigated and reported within 24 hours.
* Analyzes and resolves, or partners with team members in solving, work related problems. Supports career growth, internal movement, and constructive performance management. Ensures associate issues, grievances, etc. are effectively handled.
* Mentors and guides operational leaders to cultivate effective leadership. Design collaborative initiatives to inspire and engage the team to achieve goals. Provides coaching and corrective action promptly, to ensure that team members receiving feedback are supported to meet shared performance goals.
* Onboards new team members and supports cross-functional learning to continue production during personnel shortages.
* Maintains time and production records and approves overtime when essential, while keeping overtime at acceptable levels.
* Collaborates with outside sales to ensure order accuracy and properly scheduled customer deliveries by Airgas trucks.
* Monitors SAP reports daily such as open order/delivery reports, billing and delivery block reports and open Purchase Order (PO) reports.
* Oversees employee development in procedural areas such as following all Airgas Standard Operating Procedures (SOPS) and safety regulations.
* Run recurring orders for the next day's deliveries.
* Route all the trucks and PGI tickets.
* Complete Daily Cycle Counts.

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**
----------------------------------------------------

**Are you a MATCH?**
--------------------

**Required Qualifications**

* High School Diploma or GED
* A total of five (5) years of industry experience to include a minimum of two (2) years of demonstrated experience working in a supervisory/leadership role. Prefer prior experience with compressed/packaged gases.

**Prefered Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree
* Prior experience utilizing SAP preferred.
* Intermediate knowledge of Google suite applications
* Strong analytical skills and a thorough understanding of how to leverage metrics and related tools to improve production efficiency and effectiveness.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills. Communication skills that ensure a smooth flow of information between self and others through clear speaking and writing, encouragement of open expression of ideas, and effective listening.

* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to deal effectively with others in both favorable and unfavorable situations regardless of status of position. Accepts cultural diversity and establishes effective working relationships.
* Demonstrated knowledge of addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division in all units of measure using whole numbers, fractions and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratios, and percent.

* Lives by Airgas safety programs, OSHA, and all related rules, regulations, procedures which are applicable to this position’s responsibilities

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**Benefits**

We care about and support our Airgas Families. This is evident not only through our competitive compensation but also through a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision plans, short-term and long-term disability, life and accidental death and dismemberment (AD&D) insurance, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), pre-tax commuter transportation benefit, parental leave, vacation, sick time, floating holidays, jury duty and funeral/bereavement leave, and paid holidays for all eligible full-time employees.

Additionally, we offer our eligible employees a 401k plan with company matching funds, tuition reimbursement, discounted college tuition for eligible employees’ dependents, and an Airgas Scholarship Program for dependent children.

Associates who are members of collective bargaining units should review their bargaining agreement to determine whether they are eligible for some or all of the benefits described here and to see any special terms or conditions for eligibility.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**Your DIFFERENCES enhance our PERFORMANCE**

At Airgas, we are committed to building a workplace that embraces the diversity of our employees, our customers, patients, community stakeholders and cultures across the world.

We welcome and consider applications from all qualified applicants, regardless of their race, gender, sexual orientation, religion, disability or any other protected characteristic. We strongly believe a diverse organization opens up opportunities for people to express their talent, both individually and collectively and it helps foster our ability to innovate by living our fundamentals, acting for our success and creating an engaging environment in a changing world.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**About Airgas**

Airgas, an Air Liquide company, is a leading U.S. supplier of industrial, medical and specialty gases, as well as hardgoods and related products; one of the largest U.S. suppliers of safety products; and a leading U.S. supplier of ammonia products and process chemicals. Through the passion and diversity of its 18,000 associates, Airgas fosters a culture of safety, customer success, sustainability and innovation. Airgas associates are empowered to share ideas, take initiative and make decisions.

Airgas is a subsidiary of Air Liquide, a world leader in gases, technologies and services for industry and healthcare. Present in 60 countries with approximately 66,500 employees, Air Liquide serves more than 4 million customers and patients.

Join us for a stimulating experience: At Airgas, you matter and so does the work you do. As a member of our team, you play an important role in the success of your team, making sure our products are created sustainably and delivered safely and efficiently. In turn, you’ll find a welcoming workplace where you’re valued for who you are and where you can fill your potential while growing a fulfilling career — whatever path you choose.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We welcome all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Airgas, an Air Liquide Company is a Government contractor subject to the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act of 1974 and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973.

**Job Description:**

Hitachi Energy is recruiting for a Director of Operations. The role will be based in Jefferson City, Missouri manufacturing plant. This is Hitachi Energy's largest plant globally and we will offer relocation assistance. The role will be responsible for overseeing and optimizing all operational activities to ensure efficiency, productivity, and profitability across designated operational manufacturing value stream. This role requires a strategic leader capable of driving continuous improvement and fostering a culture of operational excellence.

new_roles.description:
**Work Schedule**

Standard (Mon-Fri)

**Environmental Conditions**

Office

**Job Description**

Here at Thermo Fisher Scientific, our industry-leading scale means unparalleled commercial reach, unique customer access, and a global footprint. Our broad customer base—from research and clinical laboratories to commercial manufacturing—enables you to make a meaningful impact every day. Join our team and help build the capabilities that enable exceptional customer service across one of the world's largest scientific organizations.

**Location**: On-site in Tewksbury, MA is highly preferred; *potential* flexibility for remote candidates aligned to Eastern Time Zone. Relocation assistance is NOT provided.

* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.
* Must be able to pass a comprehensive background check, which includes a drug screening.

**Position Summary**

The **Director of Product Management & Global Operations** is responsible for defining and advancing the global capabilities that enable consistent, scalable, and industry-leading service delivery across Thermo Fisher Scientific's global service organization.

Reporting into this role are the leaders responsible for Service Product Management, Service Platforms, and our Global Technical Support leaders representing a global organization of approximately 100 colleagues.

This leader establishes the strategy, governance, and operational frameworks that enable service excellence through standardized processes, knowledge management, digital service platforms, technical support, escalation management, and service lifecycle governance. Working across Product Management, Engineering, Digital, Commercial, Quality, and Regional Service organizations, the Global Service Capability Leader ensures service teams worldwide have the tools, processes, knowledge, and capabilities needed to deliver exceptional customer outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Global Service Capability Strategy**

* Define and execute the global strategy for service capabilities aligned with business growth objectives.
* Develop enterprise standards that improve service consistency, efficiency, and customer experience across all regions.
* Build scalable operational frameworks supporting future growth and digital transformation.
* Establish governance for global service capabilities and operational excellence initiatives.

**Service Lifecycle Management**

* Lead the global governance of service lifecycle management from New Product Introduction (NPI) through End-of-Life (EOL).
* Ensure global service readiness for new products, software, and technologies.
* Partner with Product Management and Engineering to establish supportability requirements early in product development.
* Standardize lifecycle planning, service documentation, training, spare parts readiness, and support models.

**Knowledge Management & Service Enablement**

* Own the global knowledge management strategy supporting service engineers and technical support organizations.
* Develop standardized technical content, troubleshooting guides, repair procedures, and digital knowledge assets.
* Drive adoption of Knowledge-Centered Service (KCS) principles to improve service effectiveness.
* Ensure service knowledge remains accurate, accessible, and continuously improved.

**Technical Support & Escalation Management**

* Lead the global technical support organization responsible for advanced troubleshooting and issue resolution.
* Establish enterprise escalation governance for complex customer and product issues.
* Drive root cause analysis in partnership with Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, and Product teams.
* Ensure lessons learned from escalations translate into improved products, documentation, and service processes.

**Service Platforms & Digital Enablement**

* Lead strategy and adoption for global service platforms and digital service technologies.
* Partner with Digital and IT organizations to define the future roadmap for service enablement platforms.
* Drive adoption of field service technologies, analytics, workflow automation, and AI-enabled service capabilities.
* Ensure platforms support efficient, standardized service execution globally.

**Leadership & Organizational Development**

* Build leadership capability across Service Product Management, Technical Support, Service Platforms, and Service Operations.
* Foster a collaborative, customer-focused culture emphasizing accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Champion organizational development, succession planning, and talent growth across the global service capability organization.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Life Sciences, or related field required.
* MBA or Master's degree preferred.

**Experience**

* 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in global service organizations, technical support, customer success, or operational excellence.
* Experience leading enterprise service capabilities within complex global matrix organizations.
* Demonstrated success building global operating models and scalable service capabilities.
* Strong understanding of service lifecycle management, technical support, knowledge management, and digital service technologies.
* Experience leading organizational transformation and enterprise change initiatives.
* Financial and operational management experience, including forecasting, investment prioritization, and productivity improvement.

We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus scheme, healthcare, company 401k, and a range of employee benefits! Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation.

Thermo Fisher Scientific is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided a reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform critical job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request an accommodation.

**Compensation and Benefits**

The salary range estimated for this position based in Massachusetts is $165,000.00–$200,000.00.

This position may also be eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and/or individual performance results in accordance with company policy. We offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package that our U.S. colleagues and their families can count on, which includes:

* A choice of national medical and dental plans, and a national vision plan, including health incentive programs
* Employee assistance and family support programs, including commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement
* At least 120 hours paid time off (PTO), 10 paid holidays annually, paid parental leave (3 weeks for bonding and 8 weeks for caregiver leave), accident and life insurance, and short- and long-term disability in accordance with company policy
* Retirement and savings programs, such as our competitive 401(k) U.S. retirement savings plan
* Employees’ Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offers eligible colleagues the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount

For more information on our benefits, please visit: https://jobs.thermofisher.com/global/en/total-rewards

new_roles.title: PE Quality Senior Manager
new_roles.description:
**ROLE OVERVIEW**

The PE Quality Control Head of Department (HOD) is responsible for leading the company's overall quality management function across internal manufacturing processes, suppliers, outsourcing partners, and OEM customers for MOBIS North America Electrified Powertrain, LLC. (MNAe). Reporting to both the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) and the Quality Control Head of Group (HOG), the HOD establishes quality strategy, objectives, governance, and priorities; oversees MIP process quality, supplier quality, customer quality, and overall process and customer quality management for outsourced ICCU and HPCU production; leads major investigations and escalations; and ensures that containment, root cause, corrective action, and effectiveness verification are completed to protect customers, stabilize production, and prevent recurrence.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** *(To perform within this position successfully, the incumbent must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Other duties may be assigned.)*

* Represent the Quality Control function in executive reviews, customer meetings, supplier escalations, audits, and other strategic business discussions.
* Promote a proactive quality culture, continuous improvement, customer focus, supplier accountability, and workplace safety.
* Define decision-making and escalation authority and make timely quality decisions, including containment, production hold, shipment hold, sorting, rework, and controlled release recommendations when required.
* Supervise, coach, and develop Quality Control HOSs, managers, Assistant Managers, Specialists, and other assigned quality personnel.
* Evaluate departmental capability, workload, staffing, competency, and training needs and allocate resources based on business and quality risk.
* Plan and oversee internal, supplier, customer, and certification audits and ensure timely closure and effectiveness of follow-up actions.
* Lead cross-functional quality decisions and collaboration with Production, Manufacturing Engineering, Engineering, Maintenance, Logistics, Purchasing, Supplier Quality, Program Management, and other relevant functions.
* Ensure compliance with IATF 16949, ISO 9001, customer-specific requirements, internal policies, and applicable quality requirements.
* Develop and continuously improve quality management systems, procedures, standards, inspection controls, traceability, rework controls, NCR processes, Quality Alerts, and escalation processes.
* Review and approve daily, weekly, and monthly departmental quality reports, quality trends, KPIs, recurring issue analysis, and improvement priorities.
* Report quality performance, significant risks, customer and supplier escalations, resource needs, and recovery status directly to the CEO and executive management.
* Maintain executive-level relationships with OEM customers and lead quality communication, claims, audits, investigations, corrective action submissions, and escalation response.
* Maintain management-level communication with outsourcing partners and OEM customers regarding ICCU and HPCU production quality performance, major issues, investigation results, corrective action status, and quality recovery plans.
* Communicate directly with suppliers and oversee supplier quality activities, including supplier containment, investigation, corrective action, response status, escalation, and closure.
* Oversee containment, affected-scope determination, traceability, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive action, and effectiveness verification.
* Ensure issues are properly classified as internal process, supplier, design, logistics, or customer-interface related and assign clear ownership for resolution.
* Lead and approve major investigations involving internal defects, supplier-related issues, customer complaints, field concerns, and quality escalations.
* Direct MIP process quality, supplier quality, and customer quality activities across Stator, Motor, Reducer, PE System, Inverter, and related electrified powertrain products.
* Direct overall process and customer quality management for outsourced ICCU and HPCU production, including outsourcing-partner performance, process controls, change points, audits, defect trends, containment, corrective actions, escalation, and effectiveness verification.
* Establish and execute departmental quality strategy, objectives, policies, governance, priorities, and performance indicators aligned with company business objectives.
* Lead the company's overall quality management activities covering internal manufacturing processes, supplied components, finished products, and OEM customer interfaces.

**Required Knowledge, SkillsAbilities:**

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Word.
* Working knowledge of IATF 16949, ISO 9001, customer-specific requirements, audit management, traceability, containment, and change control.
* Ability to prioritize multiple critical issues, assign ownership, allocate resources, and drive timely closure under production and customer pressure.
* Strong communication, negotiation, presentation, and escalation-management skills for interaction with the CEO, executive management, OEM customers, suppliers, and cross-functional leaders.
* Advanced problem-solving and analytical skills using 8D, 5 Why, Fishbone Diagram, PFMEA, Control Plan, SPC, MSA, and corrective action effectiveness verification.
* Ability to evaluate complex quality risks from company-wide, customer, supplier, financial, operational, and business-continuity perspectives.
* Broad working knowledge of internal process quality, supplier quality, customer quality, quality systems, and automotive manufacturing operations.
* Strong executive leadership, organizational management, people development, and decision-making capabilities.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Word, and other business applications.

***AUTHORITYSCOPE***

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**

Yes. Provides overall leadership and direction for the PE Quality Control Department, including MIP process quality, supplier quality, and OEM customer quality activities. Supervises assigned quality leaders and personnel and is responsible for work direction, priority setting, resource allocation, coaching, performance feedback, organizational capability, and escalation management in accordance with company policy.

***QUALIFICATIONS***

*(The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or ability required and preferred for this position.)*

**Required EducationExperience:**

* Bachelor's Degree from an accredited institution.
* Five (5) years of leadership experience managing quality teams, cross-functional investigations, and major customer and/or supplier escalations.
* Five (5) years of progressively responsible experience in quality control, quality assurance, supplier quality, customer quality, manufacturing, automotive operations, or an equivalent combination of relevant experience and demonstrated capability.
* In lieu of a degree, there is a minimum of eight (8) years of progressively responsible experience in quality control, quality assurance, supplier quality, customer quality, manufacturing, automotive operations, or an equivalent combination of relevant experience and demonstrated capability.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Word, and other business applications.
* Familiarity with occupational hazards and safety precautions.
* Employees must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

**Certificates, Licenses, and Registrations:** N/A

**Preferred Education, Experience, and Certified / Licenses:**

* Bachelor's Degree or more advanced degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.
* Quality certifications, such as ASQ Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence, Certified Quality Engineer, Six Sigma Black Belt, or recognized IATF 16949 auditor training, are preferred.
* Experience managing customer claims, supplier escalations, major containment activities, audits, and executive-level quality reporting preferred.
* Experience leading internal process quality, supplier quality, and OEM customer quality organizations preferred.
* Automotive manufacturing and electrified powertrain quality experience preferred.

**Physical Working Conditions****:**

* Combination of office and manufacturing floor environments, including routine walking and standing within and between production areas and buildings.
* Frequent business travel may be required.
* Must comply with all site safety rules and required personal protective equipment requirements while in manufacturing areas.
* Availability to work extra hours to meet deadlines as required.
* Ability to move across level and uneven surfaces and to sit, stand, stoop, kneel, grasp, push, pull, crawl, climb, and walk.
