At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

Raytheon brings the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. We deliver solutions that help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression, creating a safer, more secure world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

Raytheon has an opening for a Sr. Production Control Lead supporting our Undersea Factory in our Portsmouth, RI facility. The successful candidate has experience with Material Requirements Planning (MRP) systems in a manufacturing environment and utilizes data-driven decision making to enable effective material and workforce forecasting. This role requires daily interaction with cross functional teams, programs, and business units to maintain and meet organizational goals and objectives. These groups include planning, production control, operations, quality, and manufacturing/test/design engineering.

**What You Will Do**

* Managing a highly visible area with 6 production control professionals reporting into this position.
* Set strategic vision, direction and plan to execute on short to medium term program and functional strategies and initiatives.
* Material Availability Analysis, Tracking, and Reporting.
* Manage Kit Readiness including working with cross-functional team in BOM, Material Master, Process Engineering, Operations, and Document Control.
* Releasing production schedules in multiple tools through the MRP system and confirming in shop floor system.
* Coordinates kitting process with multiple stores and consolidation areas.
* Provide production floor support including replacement part management, shop floor material staging, Work in Progress (WIP) movement through shared resource areas, completion of units in shop floor and MRP system, delivery to next step (inventory or shipment), and meeting MRP schedule.
* Control the physical disposition of nonconforming or specially handled material including Return to Vendor, purged material, WIP STOP per contractual restrictions, and configuration of components/sub-assemblies as required.
* Maintain integrity of the shop floor, MRP, and inventory systems through key performance metrics.
* Process piece part movement to support internal build requirements through subcontractors, internal shared resources, and other Raytheon Technologies facilities.
* This position is an onsite role in our Portsmouth, RI facility.

**Qualifications You Must Have**

* Typically requires A University Degree or equivalent experience and minimum 10 years prior relevant experience, or An Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 7 years experience.
* Experience in Production Control, Supply Chain, Planning, Logistics, Scheduling, Operations, Manufacturing, or other production driven environments within manufacturing.
* Experience with MRP/ERP systems.
* Experience leading daily team operations and/or comparable leadership experience.

**Qualifications We Prefer**

* Experience leading in a Department of Defense (DoD) environment.
* Experience in Special Program Access and other business systems, including shop floor data systems.
* Experience in Six Sigma, CORE, Lean Manufacturing processes, diagnostics, and continuous improvement.
* Experience driving financial performance, cost reduction, staffing, and budgeting.

**What We Offer**

* Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Safety, Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.

**Learn More & Apply Now!**

* **Please consider the following role type definition as you apply for this role.**
 + **Onsite:** Employees who are working in Onsite roles will work primarily onsite. This includes all production and maintenance employees, as they are essential to the development of our products.
* **Clearance Information:** This position requires a security clearance. **DCSA Consolidated Adjudication Services (DCSA CAS)**, an agency of the Department of Defense, handles and adjudicates the security clearance process. More information about Security Clearances can be found on the US Department of State government website here: https://www.state.gov/m/ds/clearances/c10978.htm

new_roles.description:
At Nestlé Health Science, we believe that nutrition, science, and wellness must merge, not collide. Here, we embrace the intrinsic connections of these three pillars, harnessing their collective strength to empower healthier lives. Our broad product portfolio includes renowned brands like Garden of Life®, Nature's Bounty®, Vital Proteins®, Orgain®, Nuun®, BOOST®, Carnation Breakfast Essentials®, Peptamen®, Compleat Organic Blends®, and more. We also have extensive pharmaceutical expertise, offering innovative medicines that aim to prevent, manage, and treat gastrointestinal and metabolic-related diseases.

At Nestlé Health Science, we bring our best for better lives. Our people are challenged to bring fresh, diverse views and make bold moves to empower healthier lives through nutrition. We know brilliant ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. Here we embrace the entrepreneurial spirit and collaborate with teams that champion focused and forward thinking. We are committed to fostering professional growth and celebrating the achievements of our people along the way. We offer dynamic career paths, robust development, opportunities to learn from talented colleagues around the globe, and benefits that support physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing.

Join us to innovate for impact and reimagine the future of health and nutrition for patients and consumers.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Senior Manager, Factory Engineering position is responsible for managing the engineering activities relating to the factory and provide professional engineering and strategic technical leadership in the Factory, ensuring people health and safety, product safety and environment are never compromised. Strategic leader for engineering function, leveraging Nestle’s leadership principles in the following areas; capital execution, asset maintenance and utilities excellence, engineering compliance, and sustainability.

**JOB DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Define and propose the Factory Engineering team’s plans and objectives, and monitor their implementation in accordance with the Engineering Policy, Key Principles, and Key Engineering Activities outlined in the Nestlé Engineering Excellence (NEE) master document.
* Live Nestle leadership principles in all aspects of the role.
* Set the technical strategic vision for the factory, leveraging other functional leaders and cascade objectives to all leaders in engineering department, within factory cost targets.
* Develop and maintain technical competencies at the factory, including detailed action plans, accountability to progress, talent review, career and succession planning.
* Drive equipment reliability through implementing maintenance foundations in TPM.
* Build cooperation and collaboration with the production and other cross functional teams to build world class operation.
* Improve maintenance cost structure by improving technical skill sets and optimizing 3rd party spend.
* Implement Nestle capital process to drive excellence in capital execution.
* Proactively develop, maintain and execute the capital market business strategy (MBS) to align with the business needs.
* Drive factory master planning to facilitate long term strategies across the factory for example in Safety, Quality and Warehouse.
* Ensure full compliance with all governing bodies for utilities system relevant to the Modesto site. This is paramount and non-negotiable to have strong understanding in these utilities systems.
* Maintain reliability through implementing maintenance foundations and TPM methodology.
* Develop and maintain all skillset necessary for internal management of utilities systems.
* Drive and execute plant sustainability objectives in line with market targets.
* Drive world class water management in the factory.
* Drive reliability in all electrical components in the factory.
* Ensure full compliance with Nestle standards including calibration.
* Develop technical skills in maintenance to ensure electrical reliability.
* Drive Innovation/Renovation, initiating/coordinating implementation of new processes/technology with relevant Market, Product Technology Center, Corporate and Strategic Business Unit.
* Cascade objectives to all leaders in alignment with factory objectives, and implement the strategic technical OMP and factory master plan.
* Develop a detailed cost management plan for all aspects of engineering, including year-over-year improvements.
* Develop a detailed action plan for all aspects of technical execution.
* Implement Maintenance Foundations and Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) practices.
* Leverage corporate resources and ensure compliance with Nestlé Market standards.

**EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS**

* Bachelor’s Degree (BA/BS) is required, preferably in Engineering, including Mechanical, Chemical, or Process. Experience would be considered in lieu of a degree.

**EXPERIENCE & SKILLS REQUIREMENTS**

* At least 10 years of related work experience is highly preferred with at least 3+ years of leadership/management experience.
* Knowledge of food safety, regulatory requirements for food safety and hygienic engineering (OSH&R) preferred.
* Strong understanding of, or ability to learn, the full scope of role responsibilities, including financial analysis and key business drivers such as: Nestlé Standard Costing, Asset and Maintenance Management (AMM), CAPEX budgeting and preparation (CIAT), and Industrial Services/Energy Management (NEMT).
* Familiarity with TPM and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Proficiency with AutoCAD, Visio, CDM, AMM, ESAT, CIAT, NEMT and similar technical tools/systems.
* Demonstrated technical and managerial capabilities with in depth knowledge of food processing plant operations, technologies, utilities, maintenance systems, and hygienic engineering requirements (OSH&R).
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills with the ability to apply root cause analysis and technical creativity to resolve complex short and long term issues.
* Effective communication and networking skills, with the ability to perform under pressure and in ambiguous environments.
* Experience in Project Engineering/Management, including plant design and construction.

Salary: $160,000.00 to $185,000.00 per year

Bonus Eligibility: Yes

new_roles.description:
**Job Description:**

**About the Team:**

**The Dow Jones Customer Service (DJCS) mission is to provide great service for our customers and great experiences for our people.**

Our team has the privilege of delivering impactful experiences by helping our customers access the trusted news and business information published and produced by our marquee brands including, The Wall Street Journal, Barron’s, MarketWatch, Dow Jones Factiva and Dow Jones Risk & Compliance. You will find that we are a collaborative group, focused on delivering excellence during every customer interaction. We encourage anyone that wants to join us in our mission to apply.

**About the Role:**

The Senior Manager, Training & Quality Assurance is responsible for new hire training, ongoing learning, knowledge management, and quality assurance across DJCS globally. You will report to the Vice President of Customer Support Operations and be based in our New Jersey office.

**You Will**

* Own and modernize curricula across DJCS, defining content, sequence, timing, delivery methods, and readiness standards to shorten time to proficiency and support development beyond initial onboarding. Coordinate Training-led modules and specialist instruction from hiring teams within the agreed plan.
* Lead the expansion of web-based, self-paced learning for onboarding and ongoing uptraining, combining it with live instruction, systems practice, and shadowing where appropriate.
* Improve knowledge accuracy, usability, adoption, and maintenance, and prepare the team, content, and working practices for AI-enabled tools.
* Lead the adoption and validation of automated quality management (AQM) across teams and contact types, establish standards for coaching and performance scoring, and redeploy human QA toward targeted investigation and improvement.
* Develop staff capabilities and close Consumer/B2B knowledge gaps through cross-training and shared responsibilities, identifying where tools or specialist support are needed.
* Manage training capacity and delivery, oversee curriculum standards and trainer quality across outsourcing partners, and extend product training and onboarding capability beyond DJCS.
* Partner with stakeholders to understand needs, agree priorities and delivery commitments, and communicate progress and tradeoffs. Measure both program results and stakeholder feedback to ensure the team delivers effective support and a reliable partnership.

**Who you Are**

* You set a clear direction, challenge established approaches, and turn ideas into practical improvements.
* You are resourceful and persistent, working through obstacles and balancing change with daily operational demands.
* You develop people and deliver through others, setting clear expectations, building skills, and getting into the details when needed.
* You build stakeholder trust through responsiveness, honest communication, and follow-through.
* You use data, employee and stakeholder feedback, and testing to set priorities, make decisions, and measure results.

**You Have**

* 7+ years of relevant experience.
* Experience managing a training or related performance improvement team in a contact center environment, including developing staff capabilities.
* Demonstrated success leading changes to onboarding or ongoing learning, with measurable improvements in proficiency, productivity, and learning effectiveness.
* Experience leading blended learning development and delivery, including self-paced digital content, through internal teams or external specialists.
* Experience using quality evaluation or interaction analytics to identify performance gaps and measure the results of improvement initiatives.
* Experience delivering cross-functional initiatives against agreed commitments, supported by examples of effective stakeholder partnerships.
* Ability to travel up to 20%, both domestically and internationally.
* Experience implementing or expanding AQM (preferred).
* Experience managing knowledge resources or implementing AI-enabled learning, knowledge, or employee-support tools (preferred).
* Experience selecting or managing learning technology, external specialists, or outsourced training and QA programs (preferred).

**The role**
------------

**Build our future together:**

At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. We’re hiring a Senior Manager Quality Control (QC) Lab Operations to support our teams at our new highly automated drug substance manufacturing facility. The Senior Manager, QC Lab Operations leads a team who supports the technical and operational lifecycle of assigned QC laboratories, including new lab builds, fit-outs, relocations; new technology implementation; and continuous capability upgrades. The role sets strategy for lab operations, accounting for testing demand, equipment utilization, capacity, sample and data flow, and staffing. They partner with internal partners to resolve cross-functional conflicts and schedule, resource, and compliance risks. The role ensures changes meet FDA cGMP requirements and ALCOA+ data integrity principles. Represents the team during regulatory inspections and internal audits. Oversees hiring, training, performance management, and development of team members while standardizing lab implementation practices across sites.

**When & where:**

* Location: Rensselaer, New York, United States
* Work model: Monday-Friday, 8am-4:30pm
* Travel: 50% domestic- mostly capital region

**Discover your role:**

* Lead and develop a larger team, own organizational design, headcount planning, and workforce strategy for QC lab technology and facilities delivery
* Build the leadership pipeline through talent calibration and stretch assignments; set the competency framework managers apply, and hold them accountable for team performance, coaching quality, and employee relations outcomes
* Ensure training compliance and a site-wide skills strategy (equipment qualification, CSV, LIMS and CDS integration, GMP authorship); identify capability gaps
* Lead the integrated portfolio of lab builds, technology implementations, and upgrades, with accountability for capital and project spend, schedule, and resource allocation
* Set prioritization criteria, balance resources across managers’ portfolios, and resolve cross-portfolio conflicts; sponsor business cases and scope trade-off recommendations tied to site strategy
* Serve as QC’s design authority for lab technology delivery; set standards for URS content, assay-to-space and material flow design, and lab bus, LIMS, and CDS integration so data integrity is designed in rather than remediated later
* Represent QC Lab Operations at executive and cross-functional forums on design, vendor strategy, and value engineering; own the QC position on any scope reduction
* Act as senior escalation points for critical issues during installation, FAT and SAT, qualification, and post-handover support; make risk-based decisions with Engineering, QA, and IT
* Accountable for deliverable compliance with cGMP, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, and site data integrity requirements; define the quality gates managers apply before QA review
* Lead all aspects of change control, deviation, and CAPA performance; set expectations for investigation quality and closure timeliness; own the data integrity gap assessment and remediation roadmap, reporting progress to QC and QA leadership
* Serve as senior spokesperson in regulatory inspections and internal audits; prepare managers and SMEs to defend qualification and implementation records
* Set standard templates, work instructions, and delivery methods across all project types, and institutionalize lessons learned into standards, planning assumptions, and vendor strategy
* Partner with QC and site leadership on the multi-year technology roadmap, assessing automation, sample management, and digital integration against projected demand
* Define the function’s performance metrics (on-time breakthrough delivery, right-first-time qualification, post-handover issue rate) and use trends to drive resource, process, and make investment decisions

**This role requires:**

* BS/BA in Life Sciences, Chemistry, Engineering or a related field and 8+ years of experience
* Previous people leadership/ supervisory experience
* Led, or held a core role on, a build, relocation, major fit-out, or significant technology implementation from requirements through handover
* Experience supporting GMP inspections or internal audits, including presenting and defending records

new_roles.description:
**Location:** Alhambra, CA (Onsite)

 

**Our Team**

SPP is a vertically integrated photonics business focused on the design, fabrication, and delivery of Indium Phosphide (InP) semiconductor laser and gain chips. SPP operates two wafer fabrication facilities in Southern California supporting advanced photonic devices and customer die demand.

 

**Job Summary**

The Sr. Manager, Fab Quality Engineering serves as the senior quality leader within SPP Operations and is responsible for building and leading the manufacturing quality organization across both fabrication facilities. The role establishes quality systems, inspection practices, quality metrics, and quality culture while partnering closely with Operations, Engineering, and the Sr. Manager, Photonics Quality Engineering to support business growth and manufacturing excellence.

This position provides leadership for manufacturing quality strategy, execution, and organizational development across both fabrication facilities and is expected to maintain a strong presence on the manufacturing floor. The role supports Epitaxial Growth, Wafer Fabrication, Bar Processing, Chip Processing, and Test Operations, and works closely with Epitaxy, Process, Product, and Equipment Engineering, Manufacturing Operations, Planning, Supply Chain, Test Operations, and Reliability & Failure Analysis.

 

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build and lead the SPP Fab Quality organization across both fabrication facilities
* Recruit, develop, and manage quality inspectors while building future technician and quality engineering capabilities
* Establish quality procedures, metrics, escalation processes, reporting systems, and a culture of quality ownership and continuous improvement.
* Establish incoming inspection processes, acceptance criteria, and material-control procedures for critical materials including III-V substrates, epitaxial source materials, specialty gases, precious metals, process chemicals, and optical and test consumables
* Verify material certifications; establish supplier qualification, monitoring, corrective-action, and containment processes
* Ensure traceability and disposition tracking.
* Develop and implement in-process quality control systems, containment and escalation processes for quality excursions, and process controls across manufacturing operations
* Monitor process performance and quality trends
* Drive reduction of defects, scrap, rework, and quality escapes; and ensure consistent quality practices across both fabs.
* Implement and maintain manufacturing quality systems, including Statistical Process Control (SPC), CAPA, Non-Conforming Material Report (NCMR) processes, FMEA, and process control plans
* Provide independent quality review and approval of Engineering Change Notices (ECNs), process changes, and manufacturing transfers
* Establish and maintain ESD control programs and quality documentation and records.
* Lead investigations of manufacturing quality excursions and process escapes in partnership with Process Engineering and Product Engineering
* Monitor process capability (Cp/Cpk)
* Provide quality leadership for measurement-system capability and MSA activities
* Support tool and process qualification and requalification
* Use quality data to improve process stability, defect reduction, and yield.
* Maintain audit readiness across both fabrication facilities
* Support internal, customer, and ISO audits
* Support contamination-control initiatives and cleanroom environmental monitoring
* Ensure quality documentation meets compliance requirements
* Partner with the Sr. Manager, Photonics Quality Engineering on corporate quality initiatives and enterprise quality alignment.
Other relevant tasks, as assigned. 

 
 

**Minimum Qualifications (Education & Experience)**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Physics, Materials Science, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related technical discipline
* Experience: 7+ years of manufacturing quality experience within wafer fabrication, photonics, compound semiconductor, or related advanced manufacturing environments
* Leadership: 3+ years of people leadership experience
* Strong knowledge of SPC, CAPA, NCMR, FMEA, Control Plans, MSA, and manufacturing quality systems
* Experience leading root-cause investigations and corrective-action programs
* Experience supporting semiconductor wafer fabrication or advanced manufacturing operations
* Strong communication, leadership, and organizational skills
Experience working effectively across Operations and Engineering functions 

 

**Desired Qualifications**

* Experience in wafer-fab quality within silicon semiconductor, compound semiconductor, photonics, III-V semiconductor, optoelectronics, or optical communications manufacturing environments
* Experience supporting epitaxial growth operations
* Experience building or scaling manufacturing quality organizations within multi-site manufacturing environments
* Experience with supplier-quality programs and semiconductor MES systems
* Comfortable operating in evolving, high-mix manufacturing environments with limited historical data
Desire to learn InP epitaxial growth, wafer fabrication, and photonics manufacturing technologies 

 

The intent of this job description is to describe the major duties and responsibilities performed by incumbents of this job. Incumbents may be required to perform job-related tasks other than those specifically included in this description.

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Performance and Quality
new_roles.description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

As the Senior Manager, Performance and Quality, you'll lead proposal development and formal client responses for the account, and coordinate the team's responses to client, external, and government audits. You'll turn complex contract, pricing, performance guarantee, and operational requirements into accurate, persuasive, on-time submissions. Every commitment and audit response you produce is supported, traceable, and clear to the client. In Finance and Contract Compliance, you'll link what proposals promise to how performance and quality are checked through audits and corrective action. You will also project-manage implementations and changes on the account.

**Primary responsibilities**
----------------------------

* Develop proposal strategies and response plans for renewals, RFPs, RFIs, client-requested program and benefit-change proposals, and contract amendments that align with account objectives and client requirements.
* Manage the end-to-end development and submission of proposals and formal client responses, from requirement intake through final review and delivery.
* Partner with account, executive, Finance, Legal, Clinical, and Operations leadership to define key messages and value propositions, and confirm that pricing, performance guarantee, and contract commitments are accurate and approved before submission.
* Write clear, persuasive, client-ready narratives and executive communications about capabilities, program results, and positions, and represent the team in client meetings on proposals and deliverables.
* Lead project management for implementations and account changes, such as new programs, vendor transitions, and benefit or system changes. Build and manage project plans for these and for RFPs, renewals, contract amendments, client deliverables, and audit responses, with timelines, milestones, owners, and dependencies. Plan for compressed client turnaround times and escalate at-risk items early.
* Research client needs, program developments, and market and competitive trends to inform proposal strategy and client recommendations.
* Implement standardized templates, content libraries, style guides, and quality checklists for proposals and audit responses, and train contributors to use them.
* Support contract negotiations during RFPs and amendments by coordinating redlines and negotiating items with Legal and leadership, and documenting each decision to keep, trade, or drop an item, with its approver, so the rationale stays on record.
* Own the audit request log and coordinate intake, scoping, ownership, and evidence production for client, external, and government audits of the account, including third-party audits triggered by performance guarantee escalation provisions.
* Perform quality reviews of audit responses and evidence packages to confirm every part of the request is addressed, amounts reconcile, and the response is clear to an independent reviewer; coordinate secure submission and retain final versions.
* Maintain internal corrective action plans (CAPs) for known contract breaches, so completed fixes are documented before the client asks, and lead the response when the client invokes the contract's formal CAP process. Track audit findings, management responses, fixes, and closeout against contract timelines, and report recurring performance and quality themes to leadership.

**Key deliverables**
--------------------

* Proposal and client-response calendar, plus a project plan for each RFP, renewal, contract amendment, implementation, and major account change.
* Proposal strategies and response plans for renewals, RFPs, RFIs, and client-requested proposals.
* Standard content library, templates, style guide, and quality checklist.
* Commitment and negotiating-items log tying each commitment and redline decision to its approver and source.
* Audit request log, scope and ownership matrix, and evidence-package standards.
* Internal CAP register for known contract breaches, plus a findings, management-response, and corrective-action tracker and audit closeout packages.
* Leadership summaries of open proposals, implementation and change status, at-risk deliverables, and audit status.

***\*\*\*This is a remote role, but the ideal candidate will live in the Eastern Time Zone\*\*\****

**Minimum qualifications**

* 7+ years of work experience.
* Experience managing end-to-end proposal or RFP responses for complex healthcare or PBM clients.
* Experience planning, executing, and delivering across concurrent deadlines and owners.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint, and proposal content-management tools.

**Preferred qualifications**

* PBM, health plan, or government program experience, including implementations or vendor transitions.
* Experience coordinating audits, regulatory requests, or evidence-based client reviews.
* Experience validating pricing, performance guarantee, or contract commitments in proposals.
* Proposal management or project management certification.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

**Pay Range**

The typical pay range for this role is:

$67,900.00 - $182,549.00

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors. This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above. This position also includes an award target in the company’s equity award program.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

**Great benefits for great people**

We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

 
This full‑time position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues and their families. The benefits for this position include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement savings options, wellness programs, and other resources, based on eligibility.

Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments.

 
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 11/14/2026

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state and local laws.

new_roles.title: Senior Manager - Technology Operations Engineering
new_roles.description:
Joining Amex Tech means discovering and shaping your contribution to something big. Here, you can work alongside talented tech teams and build a unique career with the Powerful Backing of American Express. With a range of opportunities to work with the latest technologies, and a commitment to back the broader engineering community through open source, our mission is to power your success. Because Amex Tech is powered by our technology, our culture, and our colleagues.

We are seeking an experienced and technically strong **Senior Manager – Technology Operations Engineering** to lead Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Application Production Support, and operational excellence for enterprise Contact Center Transformation platforms.

This role will be responsible for ensuring the **end-to-end availability, reliability, performance, scalability, and operational stability** of mission-critical voice platforms, contact center applications, cloud-native services, intelligent voice bots, and AI-powered customer engagement solutions.

The ideal candidate will have extensive hands-on experience with **Google Cloud Platform (GCP), SRE practices, enterprise application support, Five9, Genesys, telephony technologies, full-stack observability, distributed tracing, and incident management** . The role also requires knowledge of emerging technologies, including Agentic AI frameworks, AI agent monitoring, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.

The Senior Manager will lead engineering teams responsible for 24x7 production support, proactive monitoring, incident resolution, problem management, change management, automation, and continuous reliability improvements across complex, distributed contact center ecosystems.

 

* **Education & Professional Experience:** Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience, with **10+ years of experience** in Technology Operations, Site Reliability Engineering, Application Production Support, or Cloud Engineering, including **5+ years in technical leadership or engineering management roles** .

* **Site Reliability Engineering & Application Support:** Extensive hands-on experience in **SRE, enterprise application production support, distributed systems, microservices, REST APIs, application performance troubleshooting, service reliability, and 24x7 production operations** , including on-call support and critical incident resolution.

* **Google Cloud Platform (Mandatory):** Strong hands-on experience with **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)** and cloud-native technologies, including GKE, Cloud Run, Compute Engine, Pub/Sub, Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, API Gateway, cloud networking, load balancing, and containerized application environments.

* **Contact Center & Telephony Expertise:** Proven experience supporting **Five9, Genesys, or similar enterprise contact center platforms** , with a strong understanding of telephony architecture, SIP, RTP, IVR, ACD, CTI, call routing, intelligent voice bots, and contact center integrations. Experience with SpeechMiner or comparable speech analytics platforms is highly desirable.

* **Full-Stack Observability & Distributed Tracing:** Strong experience with **Grafana, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, centralized logging, application performance monitoring, and cloud observability tools** , including the ability to implement end-to-end monitoring and troubleshoot complex distributed application issues.

* **AI, Agentic AI & MCP Technologies:** Experience or strong working knowledge of **conversational AI, intelligent voice bots, Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI frameworks, AI agent monitoring, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers** , including AI workflow observability, execution tracing, integration troubleshooting, and operational reliability.

* **Incident, Problem & Change Management:** Demonstrated expertise in **ITIL-based Incident, Problem, and Change Management** , including major incident leadership, root cause analysis, production change coordination, escalation management, on-call operations, and continuous service improvement.

* **Database & Application Integration Technologies:** Hands-on experience supporting **NoSQL databases, Google Cloud Firestore, Oracle Database, APIs, middleware, and distributed application architectures** , with strong troubleshooting capabilities across database performance, connectivity, transaction processing, and enterprise integrations.

* **Networking, Infrastructure & Automation:** Strong understanding of **TCP/IP, DNS, HTTPS, SIP/RTP, firewalls, load balancers, traffic routing, cloud networking, Kubernetes, and containerized environments** , along with experience in automation, scripting, CI/CD pipelines, and tools such as Python, Bash, or Terraform.

* **Technical Leadership & Operational Excellence:** Proven ability to lead engineering teams, manage complex production environments, collaborate across technology organizations, and drive **SRE maturity, operational automation, observability improvements, incident reduction, service reliability, disaster recovery readiness, and continuous engineering excellence** , supported by strong communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Employment eligibility to work with American Express in the United States is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for these positions.

new_roles.title: Director, Commercial Operations and Asset Management
new_roles.description:
**SUMMARY:** The Director, Commercial Operations & Asset Management provides leadership over the operational execution and ongoing asset management of Rhyze’s Commercial lending platform. This role is accountable for establishing scalable, controlled processes across transaction closing, funding, participation, servicing and portfolio administration, while actively overseeing the performance, credit quality and risk profile of the commercial real estate loan portfolio.

The Director leads portfolio surveillance, borrower and property performance monitoring, covenant compliance, annual review coordination, delinquency management and the operational execution of workout and loss mitigation strategies. The position works closely with the Managing Director, Commercial; Capital Markets; and Legal, and coordinates with lead lenders, borrowers, servicing partners and participating credit unions as appropriate.

The successful candidate combines commercial real estate credit and asset management expertise with operational discipline, sound judgment, strong communication skills and a focus on scalable execution.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Commercial Portfolio & Asset Management**

· Lead portfolio surveillance and risk-based monitoring of commercial real estate loans, including payment performance, DSCR, net operating income, occupancy, rent rolls, leasing, borrower liquidity, maturities and concentration exposure.

· Oversee borrower and property financial reporting, covenant testing and compliance calendars; identify reporting deficiencies, covenant breaches, emerging risks and required follow-up.

· Coordinate annual and interim credit reviews, risk-rating assessments, watchlist management and action plans, with documented findings, ownership, deadlines and management escalation.

· Oversee collateral protection requirements, including insurance, property taxes, escrows, reserves, liens, property inspections, appraisals and other third-party assessments, in coordination with Servicing and Legal.

**Special Assets & Loss Mitigation**

· Identify and escalate delinquencies, maturity or covenant defaults and deteriorating credits; coordinate borrower outreach, collection strategies and remediation plans for criticized or classified assets.

· Evaluate requests for waivers, modifications, extensions, forbearances and other accommodations; develop supporting analysis and recommendations for authorized decision-makers.

· Coordinate workout and loss mitigation activities with Commercial leadership, Legal and external counsel, including enforcement, bankruptcy or foreclosure matters when applicable.

· Prepare required participant notices and approval packages; document borrower communications, decisions, conditions and deadlines, and monitor execution and performance under approved resolution plans.

**Commercial Operations & Servicing Oversight**

· Lead day-to-day Commercial operations with clear accountability, service standards, quality controls and escalation procedures across the loan lifecycle.

· Oversee transaction closing, funding, loan boarding and post-closing administration, including conditions, documentation, milestone tracking, data transfers and outstanding exceptions.

· Coordinate with internal teams, servicing partners and Capital Markets on participation administration, payment processing, reconciliations, escrows, reserves, borrower notices, payoffs, releases and related servicing matters.

· Ensure accurate implementation and recording of approved modifications, extensions and other post-closing actions, consistent with loan documents, participation agreements, delegated authority and applicable requirements.

**Operational Excellence, Reporting & Scalability**

· Provide timely loan-level and portfolio reporting to management and participating investors, including delinquencies, covenant exceptions, watchlist activity, material credit events and remediation progress.

· Serve as a central coordinator across Commercial, Capital Markets, Finance, Legal, servicing partners, lead lenders and participating credit unions on operational and portfolio matters.

· Develop and standardize procedures, controls, checklists, templates and reporting; identify opportunities for automation, integration and improved data quality to support scalable growth.

· Establish and monitor key performance indicators, including reporting compliance, review completion, exception aging, delinquency trends, watchlist resolution and transaction cycle times.

**Other**· Responsible for effective self/workload management. Demonstrates clear written and verbal communication skills. Promotes collaboration and a positive, professional work environment. Attends all position related meetings to ensure proper communication/planning occurs.

· Performs other related duties as assigned by the Managing Director

· Complies with all company policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.

· Care for non-public information (NPI) and ensuring that confidentiality of company, borrowers, and partner information is maintained.

· Responsible for contributing to a positive work environment and culture that represents the company values.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

· Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field preferred; equivalent professional experience considered.

· Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in commercial real estate lending, commercial credit administration, loan servicing, asset management, or a related field, with demonstrated experience managing commercial loan portfolios.

· Strong understanding of the end-to-end commercial lending lifecycle, including loan documentation, closing, funding, servicing, portfolio administration, and loan participations.

· Demonstrated expertise in commercial real estate asset management, including financial statement analysis, property performance monitoring, debt service coverage, covenant compliance, collateral valuation, and credit risk assessment.

· Experience identifying and managing problem loans, including delinquencies, covenant defaults, borrower accommodations, forbearances, modifications, workouts, and loss mitigation strategies.

· Strong knowledge of commercial loan servicing practices, including payment administration, escrow and reserve management, collateral protection, and post-closing compliance.

· Demonstrated ability to evaluate portfolio performance, identify emerging credit risks, develop actionable recommendations, and effectively communicate findings to management and other stakeholders.

· Experience establishing and improving operational processes, internal controls, reporting practices, and technology-enabled workflows to support efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.

· Strong understanding of commercial lending regulatory requirements, credit policies, risk management practices, and financial institution governance.

· Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, coordinate cross-functional activities, and lead complex initiatives with a high degree of accountability and attention to detail.

· Excellent analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage borrowers, lending partners, credit union executives, and internal stakeholders.

· Self-motivated, adaptable, and comfortable operating independently in an entrepreneurial, growth-oriented environment.

Pay: $165,000.00 - $185,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Remote

new_roles.description:
**Description**

 

**About Alvarez & Marsal**

Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work-guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity-are why our people love working at A&M.

**The Team**

At A&M, the North American Data and AI team, IQx (Official name to be announced) SBU is combining A&M's market-leading execution with AI and digital expertise to help clients redesign processes, improve performance and achieve better outcomes. Come be part of the launch of this cutting-edge team that is making an impact on A&M's future. Join us in making a difference.

We are seeking a Operations Director to join our team. This position is an internal role within A&M's IQx operations team, reporting directly to the COO and Finance lead for IQx.

We value a healthy work-life balance and promote in-person collaboration by providing a flexible remote work arrangement with select days in the office, as needed. Ideal office locations are New York City or Philadelphia, but this is flexible.

We offer excellent opportunities for career advancement and building leadership skills. Our business is committed to each team member's development, training, and exposure to business leaders.

**How you will contribute**

As an Operationsirector, your primary responsibility will be for program management, resource management, onboarding activities, supporting the growth for our business, and helping us thrive to achieve our goals. The Operations Director is expected to grow to support the operations functions of the IQx business more broadly. Your primary responsibilities as we launch will include:

* Lead program management for IQx, including planning, tracking, and driving to completion the initiatives that support the launch and growth of the business
* Support and drive internal initiatives, coordinating across stakeholders, managing timelines and deliverables, and reporting progress to leadership
* Establish and run IQx meeting cadences (e.g., leadership, staffing, and pipeline reviews), including agendas, materials, action tracking, and follow-up
* Help set up and scale the IQx practice, building the operating processes, tools, and governance that will support the team as it grows
* Go-to person for all staffing matters for our business unit
* Assess and plan future resource requirements, driving utilization based on a thorough understanding of current and future project pipeline.
* Build relationships across the business with internal stakeholders including Senior Management, Talent Acquisition, HR, Finance and Operations teams
* Effectively plan for, and advise on conflicts and issues, on a regular basis, prioritizing based on commercial needs and key skills available
* Build awareness of individuals' performance goals and development needs, influencing resourcing decisions that further the continuation of business and individuals' skill-set development

new_roles.title: Director of Operations
new_roles.description:
**Reporting:** 
Chief Executive Officer (CEO)

**Direct Reports:** 
Area Manager(s)

**Leadership Scope:** 
Provides leadership and oversight to all Operations team members, including Senior Multi-Unit Managers, Multi-Unit Managers, Hourly Managers, and Guest Service Hosts.

**Description:**

The Vice President of Operations is the steward of our organizational identity, bridging the field and support center teams. They spend time in the field listening to frontline employees, then bring those insights to the executive table to shape decisions. In turn, they translate corporate priorities into clear, purposeful action for each location following the principles of Unreasonable Hospitality.

More than anything, they are the guardian of what makes us *us*: the values, traditions, and shared ways of working that bind our people together. They ensure those values are felt in every location by recognizing great work, modeling expected behaviors, and making sure every employee feels seen, heard, and proud to belong.

This role has two main objectives: setting and executing the company’s operational strategy across its retail video gaming (VGT) locations, and building and leading the Operations leadership team. It requires a service-oriented, strategic, and results-driven executive who prioritizes guest satisfaction while ensuring smooth, compliant, and profitable operations that support the company’s long-term growth.

**Expectations:**

* Lead with integrity and honesty in all work-related duties and set the standard for the organization.
* Provide proactive, strategic leadership over the operations of all company locations.
* Empower and support the Operations team to meet or exceed performance standards.
* Maintain a deep working knowledge of every area of operations and step in to assist when necessary.
* Develop a positive and collaborative work environment for employees, guests, vendors, and regulators.
* Ensure the company meets state, local, and company standards and regulations, including gaming and liquor requirements.
* Maintain clear and consistent communication with the CEO, executive team, employees, managers, and stakeholders.

**Responsibilities:**

**Executive Leadership and Culture**

* Serve as a trusted advisor to the executive team and participate in setting company vision, strategy, and annual goals.
* Be a champion of company culture by leading with integrity, kindness, and a strong commitment to company values.
* Foster a mentor mentality by teaching and leading by example, asking questions to ensure clarity, and consistently following up to reinforce learning and ensure progress.
* Build, coach, and hold accountable the Operations team.
* Lead succession planning and talent development across all levels of operations leadership.
* Provide regular operational and financial updates to the executive team.

**Operations and Guest Experience**

* Take ownership of operations across all locations and establish company-wide standards for guest service, cleanliness, and sanitation.
* Teach, demonstrate, and guide the organization toward exceptional guest service, creating memorable experiences every shift, every day, every time.
* Drive operational efficiency through impactful leadership and accountability at all levels, identifying opportunities and resolving challenges to ensure smooth, continuous operations.
* Establish and monitor operating procedures for inventory, ordering, scheduling, timecards, and store audits, and verify they are consistently followed.
* Be knowledgeable of VGT machines, slot games, and features, and ensure teams are equipped to resolve machine issues.
* Evaluate and implement process improvements that increase efficiency and consistency across locations.

**People Management**

* Partner with Human Resources to ensure proper staffing levels, training and development of team members, disciplinary actions, and overall performance management.
* Establish compensation, staffing, and labor-budget guidelines for operations in partnership with the CEO and Human Resources.
* Maintain consistent communication with all levels of the organization, including in-person visits, camera monitoring, phone calls, and team meetings.
* Facilitate regular meetings with the Area Manager(s), Operations team, and business partners to ensure thorough follow-through on all business needs.
* Support a culture of continuous training and development for new and existing team members.

**Financial Performance**

* Own the company's operating P&L, including VGT performance and controllable expenses, ensuring results stay within budget while driving profitability.
* Develop annual operating budgets, and capital plans in partnership with the CEO and CFO.
* Analyze monthly P&Ls and key performance indicators and hold the leadership team accountable for results.
* Ensure strong internal controls over cash handling, deposit processes, and sales activities across all locations.

**Licensing, Compliance, and Regulatory Relations**

* Oversee the company's licensing and compliance program to ensure adherence to state and local regulations and standards.
* Serve as a key point of contact with regulators, including the Illinois Gaming Board (IGB), and maintain professional relationships with regulatory and local authorities.
* Uphold company policies and licensing standards, including liquor and gaming regulations, to protect employees and guests.
* Ensure a safe and compliant work environment by following local health codes and business license regulations.
* Ensure all employees complete required certification courses and that audits are completed and corrective actions are followed through.
* Reinforce a zero-tolerance standard to prohibit underage patrons from purchasing alcohol or gambling by IDing every guest, every time.

**Growth, Market Strategy, and Marketing**

* Identify and evaluate opportunities for growth, including new locations and market expansion.
* Analyze each local market through competitive shops, daily reports, and monthly revenue reports from the IGB.
* Champion marketing initiatives and promotional campaigns, ensuring effective implementation across all locations.
* Provide strategic direction to the leadership team to drive successful marketing initiatives and promotions.

**Safety, Security, and Systems**

* Maintain a safe working environment by overseeing safety programs, ensuring concerns are reported and resolved.
* Ensure key and alarm code tracking, camera monitoring, and security procedures are followed at all locations.
* Ensure internal systems such as ShiftNotes, Guardian, and the Point-of-Sale system are maintained and updated.

**Facilities, Vendors, and Risk Management**

* Oversee repair and maintenance programs to ensure equipment, facilities, and systems operate efficiently.
* Take a proactive approach to identifying and addressing operational risk before problems escalate.
* Manage key vendor, contractor, and partner relationships, including negotiating and reviewing service agreements in partnership with the CEO.

**Other Duties**

* Perform other duties as requested by the CEO.

**Skills & Experience:**

* Must be 21 years of age.
* Extensive multi-unit or multi-location leadership experience, including leading managers and directors.
* Experience in gaming, hospitality, restaurant, or retail operations is preferred.
* Proven track record of owning a P&L, budgeting, forecasting, and driving profitable growth.
* Working knowledge of gaming and liquor regulations, including Illinois Gaming Board requirements, strongly preferred.
* Strong executive presence with excellent communication, interpersonal, and team leadership skills.
* Must have access to reliable transportation and be available to travel to all locations during business hours.
* Must be able to bend, reach, lift, and/or carry 50 pounds.
* Must be able to maintain an active and engaged floor presence for periods exceeding 60 minutes.
* Attend meetings and trainings as required.

**About Prime Data Centers**

Prime Data Centers develops, acquires, and operates data centers for some of the world's largest enterprises. A private firm owned by a group controlling $6 billion in assets, with a 15-year tenure in technology and real estate development, Prime provides customers with ownership options and dynamic leasing models, defining a true corporate partnership.

**About the role**

The Sr. Director, Operations Excellence reports to the VP, Business Operations and leads the company's continuous improvement and process standardization strategy. This role owns the governance framework underpinning the PMO function and leads the Sr. Manager, PMO, ensuring a consistent approach to initiative delivery across the business.

The Sr. Director, Operations Excellence partners cross-functionally with other business units to extend improvement methodologies into construction workflows, and serves as a key advisor to the VP, Business Operations on operational performance and initiative prioritization.

**What you'll do**

**Operational Strategy & Continuous Improvement**

* Define and lead the enterprise continuous improvement strategy, driving process standardization and efficiency across Business Operations
* Establish methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma, or similar) for identifying and executing improvement initiatives
* Own the governance framework underpinning the PMO function

**Team Leadership**

* Lead and develop the PMO function, including portfolio governance, playbooks, training, and change management execution
* Partner with other internal functions to extend improvement methodologies into system and process workflows

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with IT, Data, Business Transformation and other functional leaders to align improvement priorities with business goals
* Serve as a key advisor to the VP, Business Operations on operational performance and initiative prioritization

**Performance Management**

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree required

* Demonstrated experience building or scaling a PMO or governance function
* Strong executive presence and communication skills
* Proven ability to work effectively with cross-functional and matrixed teams

**Preferred**

new_roles.title: Director, Continuous Improvement & Capability Development - Remote
new_roles.description:
UnitedHealth Group is a health care and well-being company that's dedicated to improving the health outcomes of millions around the world. We are comprised of two distinct and complementary businesses, UnitedHealthcare and Optum, working to build a better health system for all. Here, your contributions matter as they will help transform health care for years to come. Make an impact with a team that shares your passion for helping others. Join us in making healthcare work better for everyone through people-led, responsible AI while **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

The Director, Continuous Improvement & Capability Development is responsible for building continuous improvement capability across Real Estate Services (RES), equipping leaders and colleagues with practical skills, methods, tools, and experiences to improve how work gets done.

This hands-on role combines Lean and continuous improvement expertise with curriculum development, facilitation, coaching, engagement, and change leadership. The Director will develop and deliver role-based learning, templates, toolkits, self-directed resources, virtual sessions, in-person workshops, and Kaizen events tailored to the needs of different audiences. The role will coach leaders and teams through real business challenges and partner with process and functional owners to translate improvement outcomes into sustainable standards, measures, tools, governance, and operating practices.

You'll enjoy the flexibility to work remotely\* from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges. For all hires in the Minneapolis or Washington, D.C. area, you will be required to work in the office a minimum of four days per week.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Serve as a subject matter expert in Lean, continuous improvement, structured problem solving, change management, and capability development
* Develop and deliver CI curriculum and learning experiences that equip different audiences to identify opportunities, solve problems, lead change, and sustain improvement
* Create practical templates, toolkits, and self-directed resources for project chartering, problem solving, process improvement, root-cause analysis, action planning, and sustainment
* Design and facilitate Kaizen events, virtual sessions, in-person workshops, and applied problem-solving
* Coach and mentor teams across RES through real business challenges, building their problem-solving confidence, judgment, and ownership
* Develop leader-focused learning that strengthens leaders as sponsors and coaches of continuous improvement, helping them create the conditions for team ownership and sustained results
* Partner with process and functional owners to translate improvement outcomes into sustainable standards, measures, tools, governance, and operating practices
* Partner with Communications, Change Management, and Learning and Development to drive engagement, adoption, reinforcement, and measurable business impact

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 10+ years of experience in continuous improvement, Lean, operational excellence, organizational change, capability development, or related disciplines
* Demonstrated experience applying Lean and continuous improvement principles and methods to real business challenges, with the judgment to tailor the approach and level of rigor to the audience, business need, and complexity of the challenge
* Demonstrated experience facilitating complex business or operational transformation, Kaizen events, improvement workshops, project chartering, and structured problem solving
* Demonstrated experience coaching and mentoring leaders and teams through improvement and change
* Demonstrated experience translating CI subject matter expertise into practical curriculum, templates, toolkits, and learning experiences for varied audiences
* Willingness and enthusiasm to travel and work directly with teams to build capability

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience applying Six Sigma and other advanced structured problem-solving methods; Lean Six Sigma certification is beneficial but not required.
* Experience with adult learning, curriculum development, or experiential learning.
* Experience designing engagement strategies and leveraging tools such as Mentimeter, Miro, Viva Engage, or comparable platforms to drive participation, adoption, and peer learning.
* Experience applying continuous improvement in corporate, service, shared-services, or other non-manufacturing environments
* Solid facilitation, communication, coaching, and executive presence, with the ability to influence across organizational boundaries

* All employees working remotely will be required to adhere to UnitedHealth Group's Telecommuter Policy.

Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. The salary for this role will range from $134,600 to $230,800 annually based on full-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable.

**Application Deadline:** This will be posted for a minimum of 2 business days or until a sufficient candidate pool has been collected. Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.

Together, we are shaping the future of healthcare by harnessing technology and innovation to make care simpler to navigate, more affordable and more connected for the people we serve. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcomed, valued, heard and respected, empowering people to bring their authentic selves to work and strengthening our collective impact through diverse talents, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.*

*UnitedHealth Group and its affiliated brands are a drug-free workplace. Candidates are required to pass a drug test before beginning employment.*

new_roles.title: Director, Operational Excellence
new_roles.description:
The Director, Operational Excellence, is a hands-on practitioner who supports ESCO sites in deploying the **ESCO Operating System (EOS)**. The person in this role travels to sites to facilitate Kaizen events, take part in key EOS activities, and coach site leaders and teams to strengthen EOS adoption, practice, and results.

Site Presidents and site EOS Managers own and lead EOS deployment at their sites. This role supports them as an experienced practitioner and member of a small central EOS team. The EOS Program Lead owns program strategy and the development of EOS elements, and a peer role owns data, tools, KPIs, and monthly business reviews. This role helps sites put EOS standards into practice on the floor and brings field learning back to improve those standards.

This is a director-level individual contributor role with no direct reports. It works through influence with site leaders and teams. The initial focus is the Aerospace & Defense group, with expansion to other ESCO divisions as EOS deployment grows.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Site Deployment Support***

* Support site Presidents and EOS Managers in executing their annual EOS deployment plans toward EOS maturity certifications.
* Participate in key EOS activities during site visits, such as MDI, Kaizen events, and Gemba Walks, and provide sites with direct feedback to enhance adoption and practice.
* Help sites put EOS elements into practice, including MDI, Gemba Walks, KPI management, action management, P&R, structured problem solving, and leader standard work.
* Provide sites with continued support to improve EOS adoption, sustainment, and results.

***Kaizen and Improvement Events***

* Plan and facilitate Kaizen events with site teams: scoping and chartering with site leadership, pre-event data collection, team training, current state analysis, implementation on the floor, report-out, and 30/60/90-day follow-up.
* Help sites build and manage their CI pipeline so events are selected based on business priorities, KPI gaps, and financial impact.
* Develop site Kaizen leaders and facilitators so sites can run events on their own and meet their annual Kaizen plan.
* Document event results and savings, and partner with site finance to validate benefits.

***Coaching and Capability Building***

* Deliver EOS training on site, from leadership sessions to hands-on floor training for supervisors and team members.
* Coach site leaders, supervisors, and EOS Managers on daily management, visual management, standard work, and problem solving.
* Support site EOS Managers in developing EOS champions and practitioners at their sites.

***Assessment, Tracking, and Feedback***

* Support EOS maturity assessments and certification readiness reviews, including site tours, interviews, and evidence review.
* Monitor deployment progress, action closure, and sustainment at supported sites, and report status to the EOS Program Lead.
* Help site leaders remove barriers, and raise issues to the EOS Program Lead when deployment is at risk.
* Bring field feedback into the EOS program: what works, what does not, and where process guides, tools, and training need to change.
* Share good practices across sites and connect site teams with each other.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Business, Supply Chain, or related field required.
* 8+ years of experience in operational excellence, continuous improvement, Lean, or manufacturing operations, including at least 5 years in a hands-on deployment or practitioner role.
* Has personally facilitated 10 - 20 or more Kaizen events with documented results.
* Hands-on experience practicing and coaching tiered daily management (MDI or similar), Gemba Walks, visual management, standard work, and structured problem solving (A3, PDCA, root cause analysis).
* Experience in a company with a structured operating or business system strongly preferred. Must be a U.S. Person and able to provide appropriate documentation
* Experience supporting deployment across multiple sites preferred.
* Plant or operations leadership experience preferred. Credibility with site leaders and on the floor is essential.
* Aerospace, defense, industrial, or complex high-mix manufacturing experience preferred.
* Lean, Kaizen, or Six Sigma certification preferred.
* Must be a U.S. Person with a valid US passport with the ability to travel internationally.

**Required Capabilities**

* Practitioner first: comfortable on the shop floor and leading teams through hands-on change.
* Strong event facilitation, with the ability to lead mixed teams from operators to executives.
* Direct, constructive coaching of leaders at all levels, including senior leaders.
* Business acumen: connects improvement work to KPIs, EBIT, and customer commitments.
* Ability to adapt to sites at different maturity levels without lowering the standard.
* Ability to influence without direct authority.
* Self-directed and organized; manages a multi-site schedule with limited supervision.
* High accountability for follow-through and sustainment.

new_roles.title: Director of Operations Excellence
new_roles.description:
**Brand:**

Bagel Brands

**Bagel Brands is the parent company for your favorite breakfast brands, Einstein Bros. Bagels, Bruegger's Bagels, Noah's NY Bagels, and Manhattan Bagel. We believe in the bagel and how it has the unique ability to bring people together. Our team has a standard set of values and behaviors that allow us to spread a little more joy and happiness in the world. They let us laugh, smile, and enjoy each other’s company a little more. These are the behaviors that guide how we work, how we treat each other, and how we treat our guests. We believe that there is no better way to make someone’s day than with a warm, fresh-baked bagel and a heart-felt good morning.**

**POSITION MISSION**

The Director, Operations Excellence leads the strategy, team, and discipline that make it easier for our bakery teams to obsess over our guests and deliver great results every day. This role owns the enterprise operations engineering agenda for Bagel Brands — evaluating how work gets done, designing better ways of working, and building the team needed to test, scale, and sustain change across Field Operations and Support Center teams.

 

In alignment with Bagel Brands’ Mission, Vision, and Values, this role builds an organization that helps teams Take Ownership of better ways of working, Support Each Other through thoughtful change, and ultimately creates simpler, more consistent operations that allow bakery teams to Obsess Over Our Guests.

 
 

Department: Operations

Salary: $180,000 to $200,000

Annual Bonus: 20%

Long Term Incentive Plan: $30,000

 

**RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE, BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO:**

**Strategic Leadership & Vision**

* Set the multi-year vision and roadmap for Operations Excellence, aligning priorities with enterprise strategy and Field Operations needs.

* Build and prioritize a portfolio of process engineering and continuous improvement initiatives across the bakery system.

* Represent Operations Excellence in senior leadership and strategic planning forums, translating field findings into enterprise decisions.

 
 

**Operations Excellence & Process Engineering**

* Oversee evaluation of bakery processes, workflows, and systems to simplify work, optimize labor investments, reduce waste, and strengthen performance.

* Guide application of Lean, Six Sigma, process mapping, and root-cause analysis across a portfolio of concurrent initiatives.

* Own the standard for future-state process design, balancing efficiency, guest experience, team member experience, and financial impact.

* Ensure the team produces process maps, standard work, and tools that translate solutions into repeatable bakery practices at scale.

 
 

**Testing, Piloting & Continuous Improvement**

* Set the standard for how the organization designs and governs operational pilots before broader rollout.

* Review pilot results with senior leadership and make scale, refine, or discontinue recommendations.

* Sponsor root-cause analysis on significant recurring challenges, ensuring solutions are sustainable rather than short-term fixes.

 
 

**Labor and Inventory Analytics and Systems Optimization**

* Own labor and inventory system optimization through consistent review of program enhancements, labor/inventory performance opportunities, and cross-functional partnerships with IT, Finance, and program owners.

* Create and maintain regular reporting for Ops teams that highlights opportunities for improvement

 
 

**Project & Change Management**

* Own the portfolio of cross-functional operational excellence initiatives from problem identification through sustainment.

* Set the organization’s approach to structured change management and ensure it is applied consistently.

* Maintain enterprise-level visibility to portfolio progress, risks, and business impact.

 
 

**Team & Field Leadership**

* Build, lead, and develop a team of Operations Excellence managers and professionals.

* Coach the team on problem solving, project management, and change leadership, building bench strength for future roles.

* Maintain regular presence in bakeries, partnering with Field Operations leaders to test and validate solutions.

* Identify successful practices within the bakery system and lead efforts to standardize and scale them.

 
 

**Cross-Functional Partnership & Measurement**

* Partner with Training, Technology, Marketing, Culinary/R&D, Supply Chain, Finance, and Development to evaluate the impact of enterprise initiatives.

* Represent the Operations perspective in cross-functional and executive-level project governance.

* Own the measurement framework used to demonstrate whether operational improvements are delivering results.

* Deliver clear, data-driven recommendations and portfolio updates to senior Operations leadership.

 

**LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES (DIRECTOR / SENIOR DIRECTOR)**

* *Effective Communication:* Articulates vision and manages difficult conversations cross-functionally; communicates complex initiatives and navigates executive discussions.
* *Accountability & Ownership:* Owns budget and strategy and drives a culture of accountability; manages multi-team performance and champions data-driven decisions.
* *Adaptability & Perseverance:* Leads the department through major change and anticipates trends; drives change across functions and builds resilient teams.
* *Empowerment:* Creates space for innovation and mentors emerging leaders; designs structures for decentralized decision-making.
* *Curiosity:* Probes beyond surface issues and fosters a learning environment; benchmarks against top organizations and sponsors new ideas.
* *Self-Awareness:* Understands own leadership brand and exhibits humility; holds deep clarity on values and stays resilient under pressure.

 

**REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES**

**Required**

* 10+ years of experience in restaurant operations, operations excellence, continuous improvement, or a related discipline.

* 3+ years of experience directly leading and developing a team.

* Track record of leading enterprise-scale, cross-functional projects with measurable business impact.

* Strong strategic, analytical, and structured problem-solving skills.

* Strong portfolio and project management skills, with the ability to manage senior stakeholders and budgets.

* Demonstrated ability to influence and drive change at the senior leadership level without direct authority.

* Excellent executive presentation skills and ability to travel regularly to bakery locations.

 
 

**Preferred**

* Direct restaurant or multi-unit operations leadership experience.

* Advanced experience applying Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, DMAIC, or comparable methodologies.

* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, PMP, Prosci Change Management, or comparable certification.

* Experience within QSR, fast casual, retail, or another high-volume, multi-unit consumer environment.

* Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree (MBA or related) preferred, or equivalent experience.

 

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**

This position requires regular travel to bakery locations across multiple regions, including standing, walking, and observing operations on-site, as well as the ability to sit, use a computer, and participate in meetings for extended periods. These requirements may be met with or without reasonable accommodation.
